title: Ecommerce Customer Service Rep
description:
RED | Ecommerce Customer Service Representative (Shopify)



PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING



We are a fast-growing 7-figure DTC eCommerce brand looking for an exceptional Customer Service Representative to join our team.



This isn't just another customer service job.



We're looking for someone who is driven, adaptable, proactive, and genuinely excited to grow with a company long-term.

We value attitude, work ethic, and the willingness to learn just as much as experience.



If you're someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new systems, and continuously improving, we'd love to hear from you.





Important



We need someone who wants to build a long-term career with us. While we understand that many virtual assistants work with multiple clients, preference will be given to applicants who can fully commit to our team. As our business continues to grow, we're looking for people who want to grow with us: not just fill available hours.



If you're dependable, eager to learn, and consistently perform at a high level, there is significant opportunity for increased hours, additional responsibilities, and long-term growth within the company.





Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



* Has excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and communication skills.

* Learns quickly and enjoys mastering new systems and processes.

* Is proactive and takes initiative instead of waiting to be told what to do.

* Can work independently with minimal supervision.

* Is resourceful and knows how to find answers before asking for help.

* Accepts feedback professionally and applies it immediately.

* Is adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where processes continue to improve.

* Is willing to unlearn habits from previous companies and fully adopt our workflows, SOPs, and standards.

* Takes pride in producing high-quality work instead of simply completing a shift.

* Is looking for a long-term opportunity rather than just another VA job.



We believe skills can be taught. A strong work ethic and great attitude are much harder to teach.



Preferred Experience



Experience in the following is a plus:



* Shopify

* Loop Subscriptions

* Checkout Champ

* Ecommerce Customer Cupport

* Subscription-based businesses

* Gorgias, Commslayer, Richpanel, Zendesk, Re:amaze, Front, or similar helpdesk platforms



If you don't have experience with every tool listed above, that's okay. We provide training for the right candidate.



Responsibilities



You'll be responsible for:



* Responding to customer
s professionally and empathetically.

* Resolving customer concerns efficiently.

* Handling order updates, shipping inquiries, refunds, replacements, subscriptions, and product questions.

* Following company SOPs while adapting to new processes as the business grows.

* Delivering a consistently excellent customer experience.



Compensation & Growth



* Starting rate: $4 USD/hour

* New hires will begin on a part-time trial period

* High-performing team members who consistently demonstrate reliability, initiative, and strong performance will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time position (40-48 hours/week)

* Performance bonuses and opportunities for career growth as the company continues to expand.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with the company.

Preference will be given to applicants who are able to make our team their primary work commitment.





Our Hiring Process



We invest heavily in building a strong team, so our hiring process is designed to identify candidates who are willing to learn and grow.



1. Submit your application.

2. Selected applicants will receive a short application form.

3. Top candidates will be invited for an interview.

4. Successful interviewees will receive access to our learning materials for a self-paced learning period (approximately one week).

5. Before the end of that week, you'll complete a timed mock customer support assessment based on the materials provided.

6. Candidates who successfully pass the assessment will proceed to paid training stage, with the opportunity to become a long-term member of our team.



Please note: The evaluation stage is designed to assess your ability to learn, follow SOPs, and apply new knowledge.

Only candidates who successfully pass this stage will move on to paid training.



Requirements



* At least 18 years old.

* Fluent in written English.

* Strong grammar and communication skills.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.

* Able to work independently.

* Eager to learn and continuously improve.

* Ecommerce customer service experience is preferred but not required.





How to Apply

To confirm you've read this entire job post, please:



1. Include the word RED at the beginning of your application title.



2. Answer the following questions:



* What motivates you to do great work?

* Why do you want to work with our company?

* Tell us about a time you had to learn something completely new. How did you approach it?

* What do you believe makes excellent customer service?

* How do you usually handle constructive feedback?

* If you don't know the answer to a customer's question, what would you do?



3. Bonus Exercise

A customer sends the following
:



"I've already
ed twice and nobody has helped me. This is honestly very frustrating."



Write the response you would send to this customer.



We carefully review every application.



Thoughtful answers matter much more than generic responses or years of experience.
salary: $4 per hour + up to $200 monthly bonus

title: Construction VA | Assistant Project Manager (Electrical/Solar)
description:
Are you detail-oriented, technically skilled, and eager to grow in the clean energy industry? We’re looking for a Construction Virtual Assistant to join our team supporting solar, battery storage, and microgrid projects across California.



This is a remote, full-time position aligned with the Pacific Time Zone (U.S.), working closely with our engineering, permitting, and project management teams.



Responsibilities:

You will play a key role in supporting the project development and construction coordination process, including:

1. Preparing and submitting permit applications and interconnection packages to utilities and AHJs.

2. Assisting in solar and electrical system design coordination, using tools like OpenSolar, Helioscope, Energy Toolbase.

3. Organizing project documents, engineering files, and trackers in Google Drive, Zoho, and other internal systems.

4. Coordinating with designers, engineers, and field teams to ensure project timelines are met.

5. Reviewing plan sets, data sheets, and layouts for accuracy and compliance.

6. Supporting project managers with work-in-progress tracking, schedule monitoring, and installation progress updates.

7. Maintaining detailed records, reports, and follow-up logs to ensure smooth project execution.



Qualifications

1. Background in Electrical Engineering, Renewable Energy, or Construction is highly preferred.

2. Strong understanding of solar energy systems, electrical components, and permitting terminology.

3. Experience using design tools is a big plus.

4. Proficient with Google Workspace (Sheets, Drive, Docs), Zoho, and project management tools.

5. Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

6. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in problem-solving.

7. Able to work flexible hours and thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.



What We Offer

1. Competitive pay in USD (based on experience)

2. Long-term, stable, full-time role with growth potential

3. Work-from-home setup with performance-based incentives

4. Training in California’s solar permitting and interconnection processes

5. Opportunity to be part of a mission-driven U.S. clean energy company



Send your updated resume and a brief cover letter describing your relevant experience and why you’d be a great fit for this role. Include “helios” in your subject line.

title: Multilogin Account Setup & Security Specialist (Night Shift / Immediate Start)
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Shift: Night Shift (Philippine Time)

Position Type: Gig

Start Date: Immediate



About the Role



We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically proficient Multilogin Specialist to join our digital operations team. You will be responsible for securely configuring, verifying, and managing a high volume of digital profiles and web accounts using anti-detect browser software.



This role requires a strong understanding of digital browser fingerprinting (proxies, IP matching, OS environments), strict adherence to security standard operating procedures (SOPs), and meticulous record-keeping.



Key Responsibilities



Browser Profile Configuration & Fingerprinting:

Create and configure unique browser profiles in Multilogin following structured sequential naming conventions.

Alternate digital fingerprints across operating systems (Windows and Mac) and custom display resolutions.

Bind residential proxies to profiles, ensuring IP locations match target account regions before launching.



Account Security & Credential Management:

Securely log into assigned
 (Outlook) and web platform accounts using provided credentials.

Configure recovery
s, verify security codes, and remove third-party account authorizations.

Generate high-security passwords (24-30 characters) using standard password generators and update credentials across all profiles.

Ensure all updated credentials are saved directly within the browser profiles.



Data Verification & Tracking:

Access profile settings to confirm and record verified identity details.

Update profile labels and internal trackers with standardized identification tags and remarks.

Maintain real-time accuracy across internal tracking sheets, logging completed setups, profile notes, and any technical issues.



Requirements



Experience: Hands-on experience with Multilogin (or comparable anti-detect tools like GoLogin or AdsPower) and residential proxy management.

Shift Availability: Able to work full-time on Night Shift (Philippine Time) and available for an immediate start.

Technical Skills: Familiarity with
 security settings, 2FA/recovery loops, and browser profile management.

Attention to Detail: Absolute precision in following multi-step workflows, naming conventions, and security guidelines without missing steps.

Setup: Stable, high-speed internet connection and a computer capable of smoothly running multiple browser instances.



How to Apply



To apply, please submit your resume along with answers to the following:



1. What experience do you have using Multilogin or similar anti-detect browsers?

2. Are you available to start immediately on the night shift (PH time)?

3. Briefly explain how you verify that a proxy matches its assigned target location before opening a session.

title: AI Automation Engineer — Claude Code Skills, Agents & Next.js Site Rebuilds — $8/hr
description:
I'm hiring a second full-stack developer for my US-based multi-brand business. I already have one developer building applications from complete specs — this is a different role, and it requires a different kind of person. This time I do NOT have every detail d
. Part of your job is helping me d
.



What you'll build:



1. AI AUTOMATION (Claude Code skills, agents, and integrations). I run a small business with multiple brands, each with its own website, ad accounts, and marketing stack. I want recurring work automated using Claude Code: scheduled agents that connect to third-party tools via API (SEO platforms, Google Search Console, GA4,
), do real work weekly or daily, and surface changes for my one-click approval. Examples include an SEO content-and-technical-fixes workflow across multiple sites, and
 triage/auto-response for specific inbox types. You'll get the goals from me; you'll propose the architecture — what should be a Claude skill, what should be an MCP connector, what should be a plain script — and you'll defend those choices.



2. THE HARD PART: verification. Anyone can prompt Claude into producing something that LOOKS finished. I've seen plenty of AI output that claims to be great and is actually trash. Your value is building automations with tests, evals, and checkpoints that PROVE they work — correct data pulled, correct pages changed, no duplicate content, no broken sites, no
s sent to the wrong people. If you can't explain how you'd verify an agent's output without trusting the agent's own summary, don't apply.



3. WORDPRESS ? NEXT.JS MIGRATIONS. I'm moving several WordPress brand sites to Next.js on Vercel. This means rebuilding sites faithfully (design, content, forms, tracking), preserving SEO (301 redirects, metadata, structured data, sitemaps), and setting them up so future edits can be made through Claude Code — no page builders, no plugins, no WordPress.



4. Depending on fit, you may also work on existing application projects (a client gallery/print store, an internal CRM) — possibly alongside my other developer. Same stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Supabase, Vercel, Stripe.



The end goal: everything built cleanly enough that I can maintain and update all of it myself using Claude Code. You are building systems, then making yourself less necessary for day-to-day changes. If that bothers you, this isn't your job — the runway is long anyway, because I have more brands and more automation ideas than one person can build.



How we work:

- AI-assisted development is expected. You'll use Claude Code (I provide the plan/subscription). I care that you direct it well, review its output critically, and catch its mistakes — not that you type every line.

- Third-party integrations must stay within each platform's terms of service. If something I ask for would violate an API's rules, I expect you to tell me and propose a compliant alternative.

- All infrastructure stays under my accounts (GitHub, Vercel, Supabase, API keys). You're added as a collaborator. Non-negotiable.

- Milestone-based delivery with clear acceptance criteria. I review fast, I respond fast, I pay on time.

- Starts with a small paid trial task so we both see if it's a fit.



Requirements:

- You have actually built agentic AI workflows before — Claude Code skills/subagents, MCP servers or connectors, scheduled LLM pipelines, or similar. Not "I use ChatGPT a lot." Built, shipped, running.

- Strong TypeScript + Next.js; at least one production app shipped

- Comfortable integrating third-party APIs from documentation (OAuth, webhooks, rate limits)

- WordPress-to-modern-stack migration experience is a strong plus, especially SEO preservation

- You can scope ambiguous requests: ask the right questions, propose a plan, break it into milestones

- Writes tests and evals; can explain how you verify automated output, not just that "it ran"

- Reliable communication in English, available for async work with occasional overlap to European hours



Rate: $8/hr to start.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — applications ignoring this are deleted):

Start your application with the word SEXTANT. Then answer, in your own words:

1. Describe one AI agent, Claude skill, or LLM automation you built that ran repeatedly in production. What did it do, and how did you VERIFY its output was correct — beyond reading the AI's own summary?

2. You're asked to automate weekly SEO content publishing across multiple sites. Name three ways this could silently go wrong, and how you'd design the system to catch each one before damage is done.

3. Link to one production project you built (live URL or repo) and state exactly which parts were yours.

title: Online Fitness Coach
description:
ONLY APPLICANTS WHO FILL OUT THIS FORM WILL BE CONSIDERED:







Aligned Fitness is a faith-based online coaching company that coaches women. We currently have 200 clients on our team and we are growing rapidly. Our approach is centered around a balanced lifestyle with sustainable results - encouraging women to become the best versions of themselves that God designed them to be.



We are looking for an expert-level coach to join our team and help high-performing women get strong, build muscle, and transform their bodies. This position is for someone who knows hormonal & thyroid health inside and out – AND/OR – is pre/post-natal certified and a nutrition expert with TRACKING MACROS.



*PLEASE NOTE* Our team hustles, and works hard, long hours because we are committed to making a difference in our clients' lives, and our work truly makes a very large impact!! We need someone who’s ready to work hard, sit down at a computer for hours, and help us change lives. We will grow your client roster by 15-20 new clients per month. You must be able to handle a large client load (70-80 clients at a time) while delivering exceptional coaching, accountability, and results. This role does require lots of screen time.



What We Need From You:



-Expert-level knowledge of Trainerize & Google Drive (you must be able to navigate these seamlessly. We will not train you how to use Trainerize so if you do not know how to navigate this software independently then please do not apply).

-Mastery of tracking macros & MyFitnessPal (you need to know this like the back of your hand. Please do not apply if you've never tracked macros yourself in MyFitnessPal and can't confidently teach someone how).

-Ability to adjust and prescribe macronutrient goals based on client progress.

-Ability to create customized meal plans in MyFitnessPal within 5g accuracy of client macro targets.

-Ability to manage a high client load while maintaining top-tier accountability and results.

-Must respond to client questions within one hour during working hours.

-Must do biweekly check ins with every client to assess their progress & make adjustments to their plan. (written/video check-ins).

-Compliance checks - messaging every client in your account at least once per week to ensure clients are following their plans and staying on track.



Compensation & Growth Potential:



Part-time role to start, but will grow rapidly as the client roster expands.

Potential to earn $2,000-$4,000+ per month as the role scales with client growth.

This is a fast-paced, high-impact role. If you love tracking data, holding clients accountable, and changing lives with precision and expertise, this is for you!

title: COO / Head of Operations – $100M/year DTC E-Commerce Brand
description:
We run a DTC e-commerce brand at a $100 million a year run rate, selling physical consumer products to US customers via Shopify plus a fast-growing Amazon business. Manufacturing in China, 50+ person remote team across Asia, Europe, and Latin America.



Every department has its own owner: supply chain, support, product, finance, creative. Today the CEO leads them all himself, and this is what you take over. You lead the department heads, keep every department on track, connect them, unblock them when they need something, and hold them accountable. You report directly to the CEO. The goal is that the business runs without him.



What you'll do:



Lead and support the department heads across supply chain, fulfillment, customer experience, product, and finance



Run the operating rhythm: daily and weekly syncs, clear priorities, follow-ups tracked until done



Own the numbers across departments: stock vs. orders, delays, refund rates, SKU profitability, cost calculations



Verify claims and results yourself, from supplier commitments to internal reports



Fix broken processes, build SOPs and systems, drive hiring and onboarding



Jump into the work yourself when a department needs it, no matter how small the task



You:



Experience in e-commerce, operations, or leading teams is strongly preferred. What d
 in the end is talent, focus, and work ethic, not titles



Extremely sharp, fast learner, strong common sense



Excellent English, on calls with team and suppliers daily



Natural leader who holds people accountable without drama



Direct, transparent, trustworthy, fully self-directed



Not a fit: the 20-years-experience type who only delegates.



Offer: Full-time remote, long-term. $3,000 to $4,500/month base plus KPI bonus. Overlap with China mornings and part of US hours required.



Hiring process: short application, video intro, paid test project, live interview, paid trial period.

title: E-Commerce Product Lister
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Virtual Assistant based in the Philippines to support our growing e-commerce business. The primary responsibility of this role is creating, managing, and optimizing product listings across multiple sales channels, including Shopify, eBay, and Mirakl marketplaces. The ideal candidate will have strong attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, and previous experience working with e-commerce platforms.



In addition to product listing management, the successful candidate will assist with a variety of general e-commerce and administrative tasks to help ensure smooth day-to-day operations.



Key Responsibilities



Product Listing Management:

Create and publish product listings on Shopify, eBay, and Mirakl marketplaces.

Upload product information, specifications, descriptions, images, and pricing.

Ensure all listings follow marketplace guidelines and requirements.

Categorize products accurately and maintain listing consistency across channels.

Monitor listing quality and identify opportunities for optimization.

Update inventory levels, pricing, product attributes, and product data as required.

Perform regular audits to identify and correct listing errors.



E-commerce Operations:

Assist with order processing and fulfillment coordination.

Monitor stock levels and update inventory records.

Support product launches and marketplace expansion projects.

Conduct competitor and market research.

Maintain product catalogs and database accuracy.

Assist with product image management and organization.

Generate reports and provide updates on operational activities.



Administrative Support

Manage spreadsheets and data entry tasks.

Assist with documentation and process management.

Support customer service teams with basic administrative tasks when needed.

Collaborate with internal team members to ensure operational efficiency.

Perform other general virtual assistant duties as assigned.



Required Skills & Experience:

Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant or E-commerce Assistant.

Hands-on experience with Shopify and eBay.

Experience with Mirakl marketplaces is highly desirable but not necessary

Strong understanding of product listing best practices.

Excellent written English communication skills.

High level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Ability to f work independently.

Reliable internet connection and suitable home office setup.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with bulk product uploads and catalog management.

Image editing skills (Canva, Photoshop, or similar).

Understanding of SEO principles for product listings.

Experience working with international e-commerce businesses.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Accuracy of product listings.

Number of listings created and maintained per week.

Listing error rate.

Timeliness of product uploads and updates.

Inventory and pricing accuracy across channels.

Completion of operational tasks within agreed deadlines.



What We're Looking For

Highly dependable and self-motivated.

Strong problem-solving ability.

Quick learner with a positive attitude.

Comfortable working with multiple systems and large volumes of product data.

Ability to prioritize tasks and manage deadlines effectively.

title: Recruiter
description:
Position Summary 

You handle the full recruiting process for your open roles. You source, screen, schedule, and help close offers. You keep records accurate in the ATS and share clear updates each week.

What You Will Do

1) Sourcing and Outreach

• Find candidates using job boards, LinkedIn, referrals, and community groups.

• Run simple follow-up sequences 
, Short Message Service (SMS), calls) and keep notes up to date.

2) Screening and Candidate Care

• Screen for must-have skills using a scorecard; prepare candidates for interviews.

• Schedule interviews and collect feedback; keep candidates updated at each step.

3) Offers and Closing

• Present offers within the approved pay range; support start-date planning.

• Record decline reasons and share ideas to improve acceptance next time.

4) Communication and Reporting

• Send weekly updates on pipeline, risks, and next actions to hiring managers and the Manager of Accounts.

• Raise blockers early (availability, pay issues, slow feedback) with a clear fix.

5) Process and Compliance

• Keep the ATS clean: right statuses, notes, and reasons for each decision.

• Follow structured interviews and documentation rules; honor privacy and Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) / Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) basics.

Qualifications

• 3+ years experience in a RPO, BPO or Call Center as an escalation Manager.

• Strong interviewing and communication skills; organized and reliable.

• Comfort using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools and simple reports.

Competencies (How You Work)

• Hunting Mindset — goes where talent is and follows through.

• Candidate Care — clear, respectful, and on time.

title: Documentation & Compliance Specialist
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Documentation & Compliance Specialist to support our Texas-based Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (IDD) program. This position will primarily oversee documentation associated with our Individualized Skills and Socialization (ISS) services.



The ideal candidate is comfortable reviewing large volumes of documentation, identifying missing or inconsistent information, maintaining spreadsheets, and preparing clear weekly reports for management. Training regarding our documentation requirements and internal processes will be provided.



Primary Responsibilities



ISS Documentation Review



Review ISS service notes for completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.



Verify that documentation corresponds with the appropriate individual, service date, and service information.



Review notes for missing information, incomplete entries, inconsistencies, or documentation concerns.



Verify that documentation appropriately reflects services and activities provided.



Identify late, missing, or incomplete ISS documentation.



Maintain an organized system for tracking documentation that requires correction or follow-up.



Spreadsheet & Tracking Review



Review designated tracking spreadsheets for accuracy and completeness.



Confirm that spreadsheet entries correspond with the ISS documentation reviewed.



Verify that required documentation is being completed within established timelines.



Identify discrepancies between service documentation and tracking records.



Keep tracking tools current throughout the month.



Fire Drill Documentation



Track required ISS fire drill documentation.



Review fire drill records for completeness and required information.



Identify missing or overdue documentation and include concerns in management reports.



Maintain organized electronic fire drill records.



Weekly Reporting



Prepare and submit a weekly documentation report to management that includes:



Documentation reviewed



Missing documentation



Late documentation



Incomplete documentation



Spreadsheet discrepancies



Items requiring correction or follow-up



Fire drill documentation status



Outstanding items from previous reviews



Monthly Documentation Management



Download completed ISS documentation at the end of each month.



Organize files according to the company's established filing system.



Verify that required documentation for the month has been received.



 the completed monthly documentation package to designated management personnel.



Maintain accurate and organized electronic records.



Qualifications



Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.



Excellent written English communication.



Comfortable working with spreadsheets,
, PDFs, and electronic documentation.



Experience with Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Microsoft Office, or similar platforms.



Ability to follow detailed procedures and checklists consistently.



Ability to identify discrepancies and communicate concerns clearly.



Reliable internet connection and ability to work independently.



Experience in healthcare, medical documentation, compliance, quality assurance, or administrative auditing is preferred but not required.



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is thorough, consistent, dependable, and comfortable with repetitive detail-oriented work. This role is important to our quality assurance process, so the successful candidate must be willing to review documentation carefully rather than simply checking whether a document exists.



Schedule



Part-Time / Remote



Weekly: Documentation and compliance report submitted to management.



Monthly: Completed documentation downloaded, organized, and
ed to management.



Specific working hours and deadlines will be discussed during the interview.



Confidentiality



This position involves access to confidential healthcare and client information. The selected candidate will be required to follow all company privacy, confidentiality, data-security, and HIPAA-related procedures. Client information may only be accessed, downloaded, stored, or transmitted through company-approved systems.

title: LEAD GENERATION SPECIALIST (Remote, Philippines)
description:
LEAD GENERATION SPECIALIST (Remote, Philippines)



San Miguel Painting is a family owned residential painting company in the Dallas-Fort Worth area of Texas, and we are on a mission to become the best painting brand in Texas. We are not just filling a seat. We are looking for someone who wants a career, a team to grow with, and a place to become truly great at what they do.



WORK SCHEDULE

Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central Time, USA. Please note this is a US daytime schedule, which falls during the evening and overnight hours in the Philippines. Only apply if you can commit to these hours long term.



COMPENSATION

$620 per month base (approximately $3.58 per hour, full time), plus performance rewards. You earn 50 cents for every appointment you set, and 10 dollars for every project won and paid, meaning the client signs and pays their deposit from an appointment you booked. The harder you work and the better you get, the more you earn. Top performers earn well above the base.



ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a phone specialist role and the engine of our growth. You are the first voice a future client hears, and you turn interest into booked proposals while making every caller feel taken care of from the very first hello. You keep our calendar full, you move fast on new leads, and you follow up until the job is booked. Our motto is Crafting Excellence Beyond the Brush, and that excellence starts on your call.



If you want to clock in, do the bare minimum, and clock out, this is not the place for you. If you want to be part of an elite team that pushes each other, celebrates wins together, and grows every single week, keep reading. We build like a family, and we win like one.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Speed to Lead: Respond to and call new leads fast. The quicker we reach them, the more we book.

- Inbound Call Management: Answer incoming calls with warmth and confidence, qualify the caller, and book them for a proposal.

- Outbound Calls and Lead Generation: Reach out and follow up with new leads to book and rebook appointments and keep new business coming in.

- Keep the Calendar Booked: Fill our sales calendar, confirm every appointment, and reduce no shows with reminders.

- High Quality Conversations: Serve the client first. Real conversations book more jobs than rushed ones.

- Post Proposal Follow Up: After a proposal is sent, follow up with clients to help book and close, especially when our sales rep cannot get to everyone.

- Pipeline Hygiene: Keep every lead accurate and up to date in PaintScout so nothing falls through the cracks.

- Go Above and Beyond: Own your lane fully. Spot ways to book more and improve the caller experience, and bring those ideas to the table.



PERFORMANCE TARGETS (YOUR SCORECARD)

These break into two groups. The Daily Non-Negotiables are fully in your hands, and we expect them every day. The Goals We Chase Together are the outcomes we drive toward as a team, coach you on, and celebrate when you hit them.



Daily Non-Negotiables, fully in your control:

- 75 to 100 plus calls per day.

- Speed to lead: first call attempt within 3 minutes or less of a new lead during business hours.

- Follow up at least 12 times across call, text, and
 before setting a lead aside, and even more persistently on paid leads. We paid to earn that conversation, so we do not give up on it. Most appointments come after the fourth touch.

- Log and update every lead in PaintScout the same day.



Goals We Chase Together, we coach and aim for these:

- Book 10 to 12 qualified appointments every week. This is our north star.

- Show rate: aim for 80 percent or more of your booked appointments to show up and have their proposal run. A booking truly counts when the client shows.

- Aim for at least 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes of talk time per day, growing as you sharpen your craft. Some days run slower than others, and that is okay. Effort and quality come first.



THE MINDSET WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Coachable: Eager to learn our scripts and get better every week.

- Open Mindset: You welcome feedback and new ideas.

- Brings Energy: You show up ready, positive, and hard to rattle.

- Client First: You genuinely want to serve people, not just hit a number.



QUALIFICATIONS

- Spoken English: Clear, warm, and confident spoken English is required. This is a phone role with US clients, so strong phone communication is the single most important qualification.

- Experience: Prior appointment setting, lead generation, sales support, customer service, or call center experience preferred, ideally for a US based business.

- Drive: You are motivated by hitting goals and earning more when you perform.

- Reliability: Highly dependable and consistent, with a strong commitment to showing up and following through.

- Tech Comfort: Comfortable learning CRM and scheduling software. Experience with PaintScout or similar is a plus.

- Home Office: A quiet, uninterrupted workspace, a reliable computer, a good headset, and a stable internet connection suitable for daily calls.



WHY JOIN SAN MIGUEL PAINTING

- We Are a Family: We live by our core values every single day: Collaboration, Responsibility, Service, Quality, and Integrity. When you win, we all win.

- Build a Career, Not Just a Job: We invest in our people. As we grow, you grow. Strong performers move up and take on more.

- Be Part of an Elite Team: We hold a high standard and we push each other to improve, scale, and grow together. You will be surrounded by people who want to be great.

- Your Voice Matters: We want your ideas. The best people here step up, speak up, and help us get better every day.

- A Long Term Home: We are looking for someone to build with us for years, not weeks.



TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word BRUSH so we know you read this posting all the way through.

2. Send your resume and a short note on why you want to grow with a team like ours.

3. Attach a 60 second voice recording where you introduce yourself and pretend you are calling a homeowner to book a painting proposal. We want to hear your phone voice.



We look forward to welcoming a new member to our family.

The Role

You'll take inbound escalated calls for one of our food supplement brands, helping customers who need more patience, reassurance, or care than a standard support interaction gets. When a conversation needs a steady hand, you're the one we trust to take it from there.



A Little About Us



Raicom LLC runs a growing portfolio of consumer brands. We've learned customers remember less about whether their problem got solved, and more about how it felt while it was being solved. This role protects that second part.



You'll Be Great Here If You

- Speak clear, easily understood English and communicate naturally on the phone

- Have 1–2+ years of customer service or call center experience

- Have handled escalated or high-emotion calls before, or you're exceptionally composed under pressure by nature

- Listen for what a customer actually needs, not just the first thing they say

- Make reasonable decisions within guidelines without needing everything spelled out

- Stay empathetic without losing control of the conversation

- Write clear, useful notes and follow through on what you say you'll do

- Have reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional space to take calls



Previous phone or voice support experience is a strong plus. More than anything: we care about how you make people feel when things aren't going smoothly.



To apply, write NATIVE in your subject line and submit a short video recording answering the following questions:



1. Walk us through a call where the customer was right to be angry — not just upset, but justified. What did you actually say to them, word for word if you can remember, and what did you do after the call ended?

2. Tell us about a call that almost got to you — where you felt yourself about to react badly. What was happening, and what did you do in that exact moment to pull it back?

3. Have you worked an overnight or graveyard shift before? If yes, how long did you last, and what made you stop or stay?

title: Chief of Everything aka Business and Life Integrator
description:
Salary: $1,200 USD/month. Benefits: 13th-month pay, HMO (you + 1 dependent, starts after a 90-day probation), 19 paid days off (12 personal PTO, 3 US-sync holidays, 4 PH family holidays). Hours: Full-time, remote, mostly asynchronous, with a small window of overlap into US Pacific time. You choose your schedule for the most part.



About Me & Why This Job Exists



I run two companies, I'm building two more (because of course I am), serve as President of a non-profit I volunteer at, have a family with teenagers, am writing a book, and probably four other things I've forgotten about.



And that is exactly why we are here. I forget a lot and don't have the capacity to follow through well. I am all visionary and new ideas, but I am not skilled at execution and follow-through.  I get bored the moment something stops being new, and I am forgetful and disorganized on top of it.



I need a Chief of Everything: someone who keeps my businesses, my personal life, and everything else running smoothly and growing.  I need my exact opposite, organized where I am scattered, someone who finishes what I start.  Put us together and it's rocket fuel.



What You Will Actually Do



I need someone who can independently execute.  I need a second brain, not someone who waits to be told what to do.  For example, I am starting an apparel brand and need someone to create and execute a marketing plan, manage the vendors, and make this thing explode. I don't want a generic AI-created plan pulled together in five minutes.  I want something with an edge to it that shows you actually thought about and understand the brand.



You will also step into my personal life to steady the ship, remembering to pay insurance, plan trips, clean up subscriptions, and handle house projects start to finish.



The Culture Fit



I've had people from the Philippines work for me before, and my experience is that you are often taught to be deferential to authority.  It can be hard to have an honest and authentic conversation.  That will not work here.



I need the exact opposite. I need someone who will tell me when I'm wrong, push back when they disagree, and make a decision on their own instead of asking permission first. If that makes you uncomfortable, this role will be a bad fit. If it excites you, you may be exactly who I'm looking for. I take the work very seriously, but I don't take myself seriously. If we don't laugh every day, there is something wrong.



What Success Looks Like at Six Months



You know my businesses almost as well as I do. You've got a rhythm with me: you know when to just handle something and when to loop me in, and you've stopped needing me to explain why.

You own things start to finish, not tasks.

An online apparel store and website built and launched flawlessly from idea to live.

A live workshop for business owners, planned and filled, with the room actually full on the day.

A book project moved from raw material to a real manuscript, working with an outside ghostwriter, tracking deadlines, dropping nothing.

A physical product vendor relationship owned end to end: samples chased, a bad one caught, a call made on when to switch.



My personal life runs smoother than it ever has, because you're holding the threads I used to drop. I trust you with things I wouldn't hand to anyone else.



What You Need to Bring



Impeccable, fluent English, written and spoken. I need to hand you something complicated and trust it lands exactly right, no lost-in-translation moments.

Western/US corporate experience is a strong plus. You'll already have a feel for how direct feedback works, and understand that it comes from a good place.

Comfort with ambiguity. I move fast and I'll sometimes hand you something half-formed. Part of what makes this work is you getting comfortable filling in the gaps while you learn how I think.

If you are trying to manage 2 or 3 remote full-time jobs, this won't be a fit.  We both need to focus.  Please don't reply if this is you.



To Apply



Write your response yourself.  Do not use AI.  I can tell.



Make a connection. Tell me about yourself. If I suspect you used AI, I'll delete the application. I'm looking for a partner. We need to vibe with one another for this to work, and you asking ChatGPT or Claude how to respond to my ad will just waste your time and mine. Please be a human and try to connect with another human. Don't let AI think for you. The whole point of this position is that I need someone who thinks critically and comprehensively.



What is your favorite snack or meal? This lets me know you read the whole post.



The scenario: I'm running a workshop for business owners with 10 to 500 employees and I need fifty of them in the room, none of whom are currently in my network. Name the specific communities, associations, platforms, or channels you'd actually use, real ones, not categories, and walk me through how you'd get them to show up.



The proof: attach or describe one recent example of something you built, organized, or ran independently for a past employer.



The metrics: tell me how you'd know, in clear and measurable terms, that you nailed that specific project. What would you track, and what would "done well" actually look like?



Record a 60 to 90 second voice memo telling me why this role interests you.  Don't script it, just talk.  OnlineJobs.ph doesn't let you attach audio directly, so
 the file (or a link to it) to 
 along with your very human response to this advertisement.  I'm not looking at responses here, only ones that are
ed to me along with the audio file.

title: Surplus Funds / Excess Proceeds Cold Caller & Lead Qualifier – Mojo Dialer Experience Preferred
description:
**U.S. HOURS – PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU CANNOT CONSISTENTLY WORK U.S. BUSINESS HOURS**



**U.S. Financial Systems (USFS)** is looking for an experienced, dependable **Cold Caller / Lead Qualifier** to work specifically with **Surplus Funds, Excess Proceeds, and Overages**.



Experience working with surplus funds, tax sale overages, mortgage foreclosure surplus funds, excess proceeds, or similar claimant recovery leads is **highly preferred**.



If you have never worked with surplus funds before, that does not automatically disqualify you. However, please understand that this is **NOT a typical real estate cold-calling position.**



We are trying to locate and speak with people who may be entitled to money remaining after a **tax sale or mortgage foreclosure sale**.



I am looking for someone who can **think, communicate well, listen, take good notes, follow instructions, and help identify the correct people from a large database of potential phone numbers.**



## What You Will Be Doing



We have an extensive database of potential claimants and their possible phone numbers.



Many records may contain several possible numbers. Some numbers will be disconnected, some will belong to the wrong person, some may reach relatives, and others will reach the actual person we are trying to locate.



Your job will be to work through these numbers using **Mojo Dialer**, determine which numbers are good, identify and speak with the correct people, and properly document what happens.



This can involve more than simply determining whether a telephone number works.



You may encounter:



* The actual claimant

* A spouse or family member

* An heir of a deceased claimant

* A Personal Representative or Executor of an estate

* Someone who knows how to reach the claimant

* Wrong parties

* Disconnected numbers

* People who have moved

* Claimants who don't understand why they are being contacted



When you reach the correct person, you will have a professional conversation to determine whether they are the person we are looking for and whether they are interested in learning more about the potential funds.



**You are NOT expected to close the deal.**



Once you have identified and qualified the correct person, your job is to **schedule an appointment or arrange a handoff to me so that I can take over the conversation and handle the closing.**



## Your Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Making outbound calls using **Mojo Dialer**

* Working through multiple possible phone numbers for each claimant

* Identifying disconnected and bad numbers

* Identifying wrong-party numbers

* Recognizing when you have reached a relative or possible family member

* Confirming when you have reached the correct claimant

* Identifying possible heirs or estate situations

* Having professional conversations with potential claimants

* Asking basic qualifying questions

* Creating interest without trying to pressure or hard-sell anyone

* Scheduling qualified appointments for me

* Making appropriate follow-up calls

* Keeping accurate notes and dispositions

* Updating our records so we don't continue researching or calling numbers that have already been verified

* Immediately honoring and accurately recording any request not to be called again

* Following our scripts, procedures, and compliance requirements



You may also be provided information regarding the potential surplus, taxes owed, **judgments and liens**, and other information associated with a particular case.



You are **not** expected to give legal advice or make legal determinations. Your job is to locate, communicate with, and qualify the potential claimant.



## Surplus Funds Experience



If you have previously worked in **Surplus Funds, Excess Proceeds, Tax Sale Overages, Mortgage Foreclosure Overages, Unclaimed Funds, or Claimant Recovery**, I especially want to hear from you.



Please explain exactly what you did.



For example:



* Did you locate claimants?

* Did you cold call claimants?

* Did you speak with heirs?

* Did you work estate/probate leads?

* Did you make appointments?

* Did you qualify leads for a closer?

* Did you help obtain signed agreements?

* Did you perform skip tracing?

* Did you work with tax sale or mortgage foreclosure surplus cases?

* How long did you work in the industry?



**Previous surplus funds experience is preferred, but it is not required for the right person.**



I am willing to train someone who is an excellent caller, highly dependable, coachable, and willing to learn.



## Mojo Dialer Experience



**Previous experience using Mojo Dialer is strongly preferred.**



Please tell me specifically about your experience with Mojo.



I want to know:



* How long you have used Mojo

* Whether you have used the single-line or triple-line dialer

* Approximately how many outbound calls you have made

* What types of campaigns you have worked on

* Whether you are comfortable working through large lists

* Whether you have experience using dispositions, notes, callbacks, and follow-up lists

* Whether you have experience making appointments for a closer

* Whether you have your own U.S. phone number or would need one supplied to you



Experience with **TrackTool™, skip-traced data, real estate, surplus funds, excess proceeds, overages, mortgage leads, distressed-property leads, financial services, claimant location, judgments and liens, or estate/heir leads** is a plus.



I can teach the right person our business.



What is much harder to teach is **reliability, communication, judgment, and the ability to have a natural conversation with someone.**



## IMPORTANT – Please Read Before Applying



I receive many applications, and one of the most important things to me is finding someone who actually reads instructions rather than sending the same application to every job.



Somewhere in your application, please include **a picture of a blue 1970 Ford Mustang Mach 1 Fastback.**



Do NOT tell me that you saw this instruction.



Simply include the picture with your application.



If the picture is not included, I will know that you did not read the entire job posting.



## The Person I'm Looking For



I want someone who:



* Speaks excellent conversational English

* Sounds comfortable and natural on the telephone

* Is confident without being aggressive

* Is patient when dealing with older people or confused claimants

* Can think beyond a script

* Understands how to ask questions and LISTEN to the answers

* Can recognize when a relative may help us locate someone

* Can handle conversations involving deceased claimants and heirs professionally

* Takes detailed and accurate notes

* Is comfortable receiving coaching and call reviews

* Communicates consistently

* Shows up when they say they will

* Follows through on assignments

* Does not disappear when there is a problem

* Asks questions when something is unclear

* Wants an opportunity to grow with a business



**Communication and reliability are extremely important to me.**



If you cannot commit to agreed-upon working hours or communicate consistently, please do not apply.



## U.S. Working Hours



**This position requires working U.S. hours.**



Because you will be calling people in the United States, you must be comfortable working hours that correspond with normal and appropriate calling times in the U.S.



This may mean working evening or overnight hours if you are located in the Philippines or another part of the world.



Please do not apply if you are only available during normal daytime Philippine hours.



Your exact schedule will be discussed before you are hired, but **consistent availability during agreed-upon U.S. hours is required.**



## Training & Call Review



I will provide training on our business, our scripts, the different types of claimants you may encounter, and how I want calls handled.



There will also be **role-playing and coaching**.



We may review recorded calls together where legally permitted so that I can help you improve.



I'm not looking for perfection on Day 1.



I'm looking for someone who is **coachable, dependable, intelligent, and willing to improve.**



As you learn the business, I want you to become better at recognizing situations such as:



* Correct claimant

* Wrong claimant

* Relative or family member

* Deceased claimant

* Estate/heir situation

* Potentially interested claimant

* Claimant who needs a follow-up

* Claimant who is ready to speak with me



The goal is for you to develop judgment rather than simply read a script.



## What Success Looks Like



I am not going to judge you simply by how many calls you make.



**I care about results and accuracy.**



We will eventually measure things such as:



* Numbers dialed

* Bad/disconnected numbers identified

* Wrong parties identified

* Relatives located

* Correct claimants reached

* Qualified claimants

* Follow-ups scheduled

* Appointments made

* Qualified opportunities handed to me

* Accuracy of your notes and dispositions



Your job is essentially:



**Find them ? Verify them ? Talk with them ? Qualify them ? Schedule/Handoff to me**



**I will handle the closing.**



## Opportunity for Growth



I am initially looking for **one excellent person**, not a large call center.



If we work well together and you perform consistently, there is significant opportunity for additional responsibility as the business grows.



I would much rather find one great person, train them properly, and build around them than constantly replace people.



The right person could eventually take on additional responsibility as we expand our surplus funds operation.



## How to Apply



Please send me ALL of the following:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. A **Vocaroo voice recording** introducing yourself. In the recording, tell me about your cold-calling experience and any experience you have with surplus funds, excess proceeds, overages, or claimant recovery.

3. Your experience with **Mojo Dialer**.

4. Your experience, if any, with **surplus funds, excess proceeds, tax sale overages, mortgage foreclosure overages, or unclaimed funds**.

5. Your previous cold-calling or appointment-setting experience.

6. The types of campaigns you have called.

7. Your normal working hours and your availability to work **U.S. hours**.

8. Your expected hourly rate.

9. Your internet speed and whether you have a reliable backup internet connection.

10. Your computer and headset setup.

11. Do you have a VPN?  If you do, what is the name and type?

12. Whether you already have access to a U.S. phone number or would need one provided.

13. Why you think you would be a good fit for this particular position.



**The Vocaroo recording is required.**



I am asking for Vocaroo because this is a telephone position and I need to hear how you speak before d
 who to interview.



Please speak naturally in your recording. I am much more interested in hearing how you actually communicate than listening to a perfectly rehearsed script.



Please don't send me a long, generic AI-generated cover letter.



I'd much rather hear **who you are, what you've actually done, and why you believe you can do this job well.**



Please make sure you have carefully read the **entire posting** before applying.



I am looking for someone I can trust, train, and hopefully work with for a long time.

title: Senior Client Implementation Tech VA (Healthcare/MedSpa)
description:

Hours Per Week: Flexible / Part-time to start

Timezone: MST (Mountain Business Hours)



We are looking for a highly autonomous, senior-level Client Implementation Tech VA to own the technical and systems layer of our agency's client setups. Priority is on deep expertise, independence, and strong client-facing capability over rate.  



This is a hands-on implementation role for an expert GoHighLevel (GHL) and automation specialist who can translate business goals into complete technical systems. You will join client calls, build end-to-end workflows, connect third-party integrations, and ensure flawless execution with minimal oversight.

- Dedicated Commitment: Dedicated to this role—we are seeking a full-focus team member with strictly no juggling of other clients or outside freelance jobs during working hours.

- Experience building white-label client onboarding assets and Loom training libraries.  

Experience working inside fast-growing AI automation agencies or healthcare marketing consultancies.  



KPIs / Success Metrics

- Zero-Breakdown Workflows: All builds fully tested with zero preventable breakdowns in lead routing, booking, notifications, or follow-ups.

- Client Satisfaction: Positive client feedback on communication quality and implementation reliability.  





How to Apply

If you are a fast-moving builder who thrives in a zero-fluff, execution-focused environment and is ready to own high-impact AI/CRM workflows, we’d love to hear from you!



Please reply to this post with a brief introduction and a direct link to your updated CV / Resume (Google Drive, Dropbox, Notion, etc., with view access enabled).



Due to the high volume of applications, our hiring team will review submissions on a rolling basis and reach out directly to candidates whose experience aligns best with the role for an initial interview.

title: Social Media Specialist
description:
# Social Media Content Specialist



**Location:** Remote | **Type:** Contract (flexible) | **Reports to:** Agency Lead / Account Director



## About the Role



We're an agency managing social media presence for multiple small business clients (think local service providers — salons, auto repair shops, contractors, and similar). We're looking for a Social Media Content Specialist who knows how to combine sharp creative instincts with AI-powered tools to produce, publish, and manage content efficiently across several client accounts at once. This isn't an entry-level content role — you should already understand how to run social accounts professionally — but we're not requiring a decade of agency polish to prove it.



## What You'll Do



- Own day-to-day content creation and posting for a portfolio of client social accounts (Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Google Business Profile as applicable)

- Use AI tools to draft, edit, and refine post copy, captions, and short-form video/image content quickly, while keeping each client's brand voice distinct and authentic

- Monitor comments and DMs across client accounts, responding promptly and appropriately — using AI-assisted drafting where useful, but always reviewing for tone, accuracy, and brand fit before it goes out

- Build and maintain a monthly content calendar per client, balancing promotional posts, educational content, and community engagement

- Track basic performance metrics (engagement, reach, follower growth) and adjust content strategy based on what's working

- Flag reputation risks (negative comments, reviews, PR issues) to the account lead quickly and professionally

- Collaborate with account managers to align content with each client's business goals, seasonal promotions, and local market context

- Maintain a repeatable, efficient workflow that allows you to manage multiple clients without sacrificing quality — this is the core skill we're hiring for



## What We're Looking For



- **1–3 years of hands-on experience** running social media accounts professionally (in-house, freelance, or agency) — we're not asking for 5+ years, but you need to have actually done this before, not just studied it

- Demonstrated experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT/Claude, Canva AI, Copy.ai, or similar) in a real content workflow — writing captions, generating post ideas, drafting replies, or producing visuals/video

- Strong writing skills with the ability to adapt tone and voice across multiple distinct brands

- Comfortable managing several client accounts simultaneously without dropping balls — organization and prioritization are non-negotiable

- Working knowledge of scheduling/publishing tools (Later, Buffer, Hootsuite, Meta Business Suite, or similar)

- Basic understanding of social platform algorithms and what drives engagement on each channel

- A good eye for visual content — you don't need to be a designer, but you know what looks good and on-brand

- Experience with small business or local service clients (salons, auto repair, home services, etc.) is a strong plus, not a requirement

- Discretion and good judgment — you'll be posting and replying as the client, and knowing when to escalate rather than "wing it" matters



## Nice to Have



- Experience with short-form video editing/repurposing tools

- Familiarity with basic review management (Google, Yelp) and reputation monitoring

- Comfort presenting simple performance recaps to clients or account leads

- Bilingual (Spanish/English) a plus depending on client base



## Why Join Us



You'll get to work across a variety of industries and brands, sharpen your AI-assisted content workflow, and grow with an agency that's investing in efficient, modern tools rather than brute-force headcount. If you're someone who's already comfortable running social accounts and wants to level up how fast and well you can do it with AI, we want to hear from you.



---



**To Apply:** Send examples of client or brand social accounts you've managed, along with a short note on how you currently use AI in your content workflow (tools, process, what it's saved you time on).

description:
ABOUT US



We run Cocktail Week - city-wide cocktail festivals across more than 20 cities in the UK and Ireland, including Belfast, Liverpool, Manchester, Newcastle, Leeds, Cardiff, Dublin and Cork.



We sell wristbands that give people access to discounted cocktails across dozens of bars in their city. Our website is WordPress and our
 platform is Brevo.





THE HONEST VERSION OF THIS JOB (please read)



We have around 100k
 contacts and plan to double this in the next 6 months with quality data.



The job is to build capture pages and
 journeys that turn visitors into subscribers who open, click and eventually buy a ticket/



If you enjoy building things and looking at where a funnel leaks, you will like this role. If you measure success purely by how many
 addresses you collected, we are probably not a good fit.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



BUILDING

- Build landing pages for our lead magnets - city bar guides, competitions, pre-registration pages

- Build capture forms in Brevo with the correct fields and the correct city list

- Build on-site capture: exit intent popups, a spin-to-win wheel, first-visit offers

- Connect everything to our existing automated
 journeys

- We have working demo pages already built, so you will not be starting from a blank page



MEASURING

- Track every step of the funnel: click, page view, form started, form submitted, opt-in confirmed, first
 opened, first purchase

- Report where people drop out, by city and by campaign

- Find the worst step, fix it, and do it again



TESTING AND IMPROVING

- A/B test headlines, form length, offers and timing

- Keep forms as short as possible

- Make confirmation and thank-you pages actually do something useful



 JOURNEYS

- Welcome sequences that get a new subscriber engaged in their first week

- Re-engagement and sunset campaigns for our large inactive audience

- Post-purchase and cross-city journeys



LIST HEALTH

- Segment by engagement, city and purchase history

- Keep the list clean and protect our
 deliverability





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- You have built landing pages yourself. Not just briefed them - actually built them.

- Comfortable with HTML and CSS. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be able to edit a page without breaking it.

- Hands-on experience with an
 marketing platform. Brevo ideally, but Klaviyo, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign or similar is fine.

- You understand marketing automation - triggers, conditions, sequences

- You know what double opt-in is and why deliverability matters

- WordPress experience

- Comfortable with Google Analytics and honest reporting

- You care about what happens to a lead AFTER they sign up





NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- Conversion rate optimisation and A/B testing experience

- Experience with GDPR-compliant data capture in the UK or EU

- Meta Lead Ads

- Any experience with events, ticketing or hospitality





HOW TO APPLY

 platforms you have used and your available hours.

title: Customer Experience Specialist – E-Commerce
description:
Customer Experience Specialist – E-Commerce



Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Position



Adventure Life USA is a growing U.S.-based automotive graphics company specializing in premium vehicle decals, graphics, and officially licensed MOPAR products.



We are looking for a highly organized, dependable Customer Experience Specialist to join our team long-term.



This is not a role where you simply copy and paste responses. We need someone who can read a customer’s message, understand the situation, investigate the order, and help solve the problem.



What You'll Be Doing



You will be responsible for helping our customers through
, chat, and other support channels.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Responding to customer
s and support tickets

- Checking order status and providing accurate updates

- Helping customers select the correct products and vehicle fitment

- Answering product and installation questions

- Handling order changes, cancellations, replacements, and other common requests

- Investigating customer issues before responding

- Working inside Shopify and our customer support platform

- Communicating with our production team when additional information is needed

- Following company policies while still treating customers like real people

- Escalating unusual situations instead of guessing

- Keeping customer conversations organized and properly documented

- Helping us improve FAQs, saved responses, and customer service processes over time



Who We're Looking For



You should have:



- Excellent written English

- Experience providing customer service for a U.S.-based e-commerce company

- Strong reading comprehension

- Great attention to detail

- The ability to communicate naturally, professionally, and empathetically

- The ability to investigate a problem instead of immediately asking someone else what to do

- Strong organizational and time-management skills

- Reliable internet and a dependable computer

- A quiet environment where you can focus

- A positive attitude and willingness to learn



Experience with Shopify, Gorgias, Klaviyo, Etsy, or similar e-commerce platforms is a major plus.



Automotive knowledge is helpful but not required. We can teach you our products.



The Most Important Part



We care much more about how you think and communicate than whether you've used every piece of software we use.



A great person for this position will read a ticket, check the order, review the relevant information, and think:



“What happened, what does this customer actually need, and what can I do to resolve it?”



We do not want robotic or overly scripted customer service.



We want customers to feel like they are talking to someone who actually cares about solving their problem.





Schedule



This is intended to be a full-time, long-term position.



Some working hours will need to overlap with our team in St. Louis, Missouri (Central Time).



Please include your normal working availability in your application.



How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your previous customer service/e-commerce experience

3. Which platforms you have experience using

4. Your expected hourly/monthly salary

5. Your normal working hours and timezone

6. Your internet speed and computer setup



Customer Service Test



Please answer these questions in your own words, do not use Ai:



1. A customer writes:



"I ordered this over a week ago and it still hasn't shipped. I needed it for an event this weekend. What's going on?"



How would you respond, and what would you check before responding?



2. A customer ordered a graphic for a 2021 Jeep Wrangler JL, but after receiving it they tell you they actually own a 2017 Jeep Wrangler JK.



What would you do?



3. A customer sends a photo and says:



"This decal doesn't fit my vehicle. You sent me the wrong one."



What information would you gather before d
 how to resolve the issue?



4. Tell us about a time you dealt with an upset customer. What happened, and how did you handle it?



5. If you don't know the answer to a customer's question, what would you do?



Finally, put the words BLACK TOPO at the very beginning of your application so we know you read the entire job posting.



We're looking for someone who wants to become an important, long-term member of our team—not someone looking to add another temporary client.

title: Motel Guest Services
description:
Remote Hotel Front Desk / Guest Services VA – Low Call Volume – Long-Term



Positions Available: 3

Schedule: U.S. Central Time



Job Description

We operate a small independently operated motel in the United States. We are building a remote guest-services team to provide professional front-desk coverage when there is no employee physically at the front desk.

This is an unusual position because you must remain available throughout your scheduled shift, but our actual call and guest-service volume is usually very low.

Most of your shift may have no active work at all.

During quiet periods, you may perform other remote work, study, read, or handle personal tasks. However, you must remain reachable, have your computer or phone available, and be able to answer motel calls quickly.

This is a long-term position. Reliability is extremely important.



Compensation

Guaranteed monthly base + per-call and performance bonuses

Pay is negotiable 



Available Roles

Evening Guest Services VA

Schedule: approximately 3:00 PM–11:30 PM U.S. Central Time, six days per week.

This is 4:00 AM–12:30 PM Philippine Time 

Expected active work is often less than approximately 45 minutes during the entire 8.5-hour shift, although volume varies.

Starting guaranteed base: approximately $300 USD/month, plus bonuses for every call answered and reliability

Overnight Guest Services VA

Schedule: approximately 11:30 PM–8:00 AM U.S. Central Time, six days per week.

This is 12:30 PM–9:00 PM Philippine Time 

Expected active work may average only approximately 10 minutes during the entire 8.5-hour shift, although volume varies.

Starting guaranteed base: approximately $225 USD/month, plus bonuses for every call answered and reliability

Relief / Backup Guest Services VA

This person will be fully trained on all motel systems and will cover scheduled days off, vacations, illness and other coverage needs for the two primary VAs.

Expected scheduled coverage will normally include at least one evening shift and one overnight shift per week.

Starting guaranteed base: approximately $150 USD/month, plus bonuses and additional compensation for extra coverage.



Bonuses

In addition to guaranteed monthly compensation:

Approximately $1.50 USD for each completed customer/guest call handled

$10 USD rescue bonus when you answer a call outside your scheduled shift after the scheduled VA fails to answer

Monthly reliability/performance bonuses - $45 per month when you’re call answered rate is 95%+

Additional responsibilities and compensation may be available for excellent long-term team members



What You Will Do

You will function as a remote hotel front-desk agent.

Responsibilities may include:

Answer incoming guest and reservation calls professionally

Look up reservations in our hotel property-management system

Assist arriving guests with remote check-in

Process or verify guest payments

Provide guests with their room number and door code

Access our room-status and check-in information

Respond to guest text messages

Help prospective guests make reservations

Coordinate with our live-in housekeeper when physical assistance is necessary

Document guest problems and unusual situations

Escalate emergencies or unusual situations to the owner

Full training and written procedures will be provided.



You Must Have

Excellent spoken English is extremely important because much of this position involves speaking with American hotel guests by telephone.

You must also have:

Friendly and professional telephone manner

Excellent reliability

Ability to answer incoming calls promptly

Reliable computer or phone

Reliable internet

Ability to comfortably use web-based software, spreadsheets and telephone applications

Good judgment and problem-solving ability

Ability to follow written procedures carefully

Strong honesty and discretion when handling guest information

Hotel, Airbnb, vacation-rental, reservations, call-center or customer-service experience is helpful but not required.

We are much more interested in excellent English, reliability, intelligence, friendliness and judgment.



How to Apply – Voice Recording Required

Please complete our short application form here:



As part of the application, you must provide a voice recording.

Upload your recording to Vocaroo, Google Drive or another service where anyone with the link can listen, then paste the listening link into the application form.

Your recording must include both of the following:

1. Front-desk greeting

Say:

“Thank you for calling Silver Street Motel, this is [YOUR NAME]. How can I help you?”

title: Video Editor - Paid Per Video (YouTube Long-form + Shorts)
description:
We produce YouTube long-form and short-form content and need editors who want to be paid for what they finish, not for hours logged.



THE RATES



Long-form video: $25 per completed video

Speed bonus: +$5 if delivered within 72 working hours

Short-form video: $8 per published short

Upload package: $3 each (upload, description, metadata, scheduling, thumbnails, report)



HOW WE SET THESE



Every rate is priced at $5 per hour of real work. We timed each task type and priced it from there. If you think something takes longer than we priced it, tell us and we re-time that task type. If we are wrong, the price changes for everyone.



WHAT A MONTH LOOKS LIKE



A typical month is around 5 long-form videos, 7 to 10 shorts, and about 12 upload packages. That comes to roughly $275. Lighter months pay less. Heavier months pay more, and there is no cap on the top end.



This is part-time work at part-time pay. We are being direct about that so nobody is surprised after they start.



WHAT WE NEED YOU TO DO



Long-form: full edit from raw footage. Cuts, pacing, music, sound effects, captions, exported publish-ready.



Short-form: pick the highlight, cut to 9:16, captions, zooms and keyframes, transitions, sound effects, music, export in 2K.



Upload package: upload the finished video, write the description and metadata, schedule it, attach thumbnails, send a short report.



HOW WE WORK



Maximum 2 active long-form projects at a time. Everything else queues with no clock running.



The 72-hour clock only starts when the project is active and you have every asset. Our delays never count against you.



Sunday is a full day off and pauses the clock. Saturday is optional.



Payment is sent after the work is delivered and confirmed. Send your payment details up front so payout is fast.



You provide your own editing software. We priced the rates with that in mind rather than reimbursing subscriptions.



WHO THIS SUITS



Someone who works fast, hits deadlines, and wants earnings tied directly to output. If you want a guaranteed monthly salary, this is not the right post for you and we would rather say that now.



TO APPLY



Send:

1. A link to 1 long-form edit and 1 short you made
