3. What software you use

title: COMPLIANCE ANALYST
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



About Mostro

We sell cybersecurity and compliance services to mortgage brokers and regulated small businesses. We're building proprietary compliance solutions and control frameworks that simplify regulatory requirements for our clients. We need someone who understands compliance fundamentals and can support our control map and compliance documentation under the direction of leadership.



About the Role

This is an entry-to-mid-level operational role that bridges compliance standards with our client delivery. You'll support the development and maintenance of our control map, help ensure compliance across relevant frameworks (SOC 2, FTC, mortgage broker regulations, etc.), manage compliance documentation, and coordinate with our sales and delivery teams to ensure we're meeting client requirements. You're not just documenting — you're helping ensure our internal operations and client relationships are built on solid compliance foundations. This role reports to leadership and has growth potential into a full compliance manager position as the company scales.



What You'll Do



- Support the development and maintenance of our ControlMap and compliance documentation across relevant frameworks (SOC 2, FTC, mortgage industry requirements, data protection)

- Assist in auditing internal processes and identifying compliance gaps or control weaknesses

- Create and update policies, procedures, and control testing schedules

- Help manage compliance evidence collection and organize documentation for client audits

- Coordinate with product and engineering teams on security and compliance improvements

- Prepare compliance reports and status updates for leadership and clients

- Stay current on regulatory changes affecting our industry and clients



What We're Looking For



- 1-2+ years of compliance, audit, risk management, or control operations experience (internships and coursework count)

- Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GLBA, or similar — formal certification not required, but you should know what these are)

- Understanding of internal controls, risk assessment, and compliance mapping fundamentals

- Strong organizational and documentation skills — attention to detail is critical

- Experience working with both technical teams and business stakeholders (or strong willingness to learn)

- Ability to translate compliance requirements into practical, implementable controls

- Strong communication skills and ability to explain compliance concepts clearly

- Self-starter who can execute on defined tasks with minimal supervision and ask for help when needed



Bonus (Not Required)



- Experience in mortgage, financial services, or regulated industries

- Familiarity with GRC tools (Vanta, Drata, Secureframe, or similar)

- Background in cybersecurity or IT audit

- Knowledge of Philippine data privacy regulations (DPA 2012, NPC requirements)



Compensation & Structure



- Base salary: PHP 45,000/month with benefits

- Performance bonuses based on compliance audit results and successful client certifications

- Growth path: This role is designed to grow into a Compliance Manager position as Mostro scales

- Remote work (Philippines-based)



SKILL REQUIREMENTS



Compliance Management | Risk Assessment | Control Mapping | SOC 2 (familiarity) | Internal Audit Support | Regulatory Knowledge | Documentation | Attention to Detail

What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINKELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

title: Senior QS with Systems Mindset
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking a systems-minded Senior Quantity Surveyor to take ownership of our commercial infrastructure. This is a unique role designed for a candidate who excels at building efficient, automated systems and wants to move away from repetitive day-to-day administration into an oversight, auditing, and high-level quality-assurance position.



The successful candidate will take the lead on auditing, designing, and rolling out a universal suite of simplified commercial systems. The core objective is to standardise commercial reporting across multiple clients and projects, and to structure workflows so that day-to-day data entry can be successfully undertaken by an administrative support team.



Once these systems are developed and live-tested, the focus of this role will shift. The candidate will step up to manage the commercial infrastructure entirely—taking the lead on system governance, providing ongoing support to the admin team, and conducting high-level end-QS inputs, final validation checks, and commercial sign-offs.





________________________________________





Key Information



• Job Title: Commercial Systems & Quantity Surveying Lead

• Primary Objective: Build a scalable, admin-friendly spreadsheet infrastructure, then transition into a leadership role focused on managing the systems, supporting staff, and executing final commercial sign-offs.

• Reporting To: Commercial Director / Board of Directors



________________________________________





Core Responsibilities







1. System Auditing, Development & Iteration



• Audit Legacy Systems: Lead the review of all historically used commercial spreadsheets and tools to identify inefficiencies, errors, and manual bottlenecks.

• Lead Live-Job Testing: Roll out system prototypes on current, live projects to observe how they perform under day-to-day project pressures.

• Refine & Pivot Infrastructure: Gather friction points from site teams and administrative staff to actively modify, restructure, and improve the systems as projects progress.

• Own the Universal Blueprint: Establish a modular suite of simplified, universal commercial tools that accommodate diverse client needs without requiring custom rebuilds.





2. Administration Delegation, Training & Support



• Build Admin Data-Entry Portals: Create locked, foolproof Excel input tabs where admin staff can easily enter invoices, orders, and delivery tickets.

• Write SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures): Draft clear, jargon-free manuals detailing exactly how admin support should input data.

• Deliver Hands-on Admin Training: Conduct structured onboarding sessions for administrative staff to walk them through data entry fields, common mistakes, and standard workflows.

• Provide Ongoing Helpdesk Support: Act as the first point of contact for admin staff when a template breaks, an error code triggers, or an unusual invoice requires clarification.





3. System Management & Final QS Sign-Off (Long-Term Focus)



• Manage Commercial Infrastructure: Take full ownership of the system lifecycle, ensuring company reporting standards evolve dynamically alongside changing business needs.

• Conduct Final Validation Checks: Review and verify the data, sub-contractor liability logs, and variation trackers updated by the admin team to ensure absolute accuracy.

• Execute End-QS Input: Focus active QS time strictly on high-level, complex commercial inputs, value engineering, and final account closures.

• Draft System Governance: Enforce strict version-control rules to stop users from breaking core templates.

• Build Master Dashboards: Use Power Query to roll up individual project sheets into a master, company-wide view for executive reporting.



________________________________________





Required Skills & Qualifications







Technical & Software Skills



• Advanced Excel Architecture: Expert capability in building dynamic models using INDEX/MATCH, XLOOKUP, and Power Query.

• Database Logic: Proven ability to separate raw data inputs from calculations and dashboard summaries.

• UI/UX Spreadsheet Design: Ability to design intuitive, colour-coded data entry sheets tailored for non-technical users.

• Data Validation Mastery: Expert level at restricting inputs using drop-down lists, data validation, and error-blocking parameters.





Desirable Core Attributes & Character Traits



• Results-driven and proactive: Demonstrates strong internal motivation to take full ownership of the commercial infrastructure and drive operational efficiency.

• Passionate about process automation: Exhibits genuine enthusiasm for engineering intelligent, automated spreadsheet systems that eliminate manual workflows.

• Strategic delegation mindset: Recognises the commercial value of delegating repetitive tasks to support staff to focus on high-level strategy and final validation.

• Rigorous attention to detail: Possesses the sharp analytical skills required to identify errors instantly when auditing and signing off on data compiled by others.

• Patient and supportive mentor: Committed to delivering structured training and ongoing technical guidance to elevate the capabilities of the administrative team.

• Agile and adaptive problem-solver: Welcomes real-world feedback on live projects, actively refining, modifying, and changing templates to meet evolving project needs.

• Process-driven architect: Naturally inclined to modernise and standardise complex commercial workflows into simplified, universal corporate blueprints.

• Articulate and accessible communicator: Capable of translating technical quantity surveying terminology into clear, accessible instructions for non-commercial personnel.

• Governance and quality-assurance focused: Thrives in a position centered on system integrity, compliance monitoring, and final commercial sign-off.

Expansion Shift: If expanded to full-time, hours will increase to 4:00 AM to 12:00 PM US Eastern Time (4:00 PM to 12:00 AM Philippine Standard Time).



About the Role

We are an electronics recycling and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) company looking for a meticulous, systems-driven Data Operations Coordinator. This position is a dedicated part-time role designed to organize data inboxes, cross-reference customer compliance, and map out our customer relations workflows.

You will not be performing general administrative or social media tasks. Your focus will be entirely on database hygiene, data migration reconciliation between HubSpot and QuickBooks, and setting up clean Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) so our sales team can scale.

Scope of Work

1. Financial Baseline Reconciliation

Audit Historical Transactions: Manually audit historical wholesale transactions across QuickBooks and payment exports to extract an accurate customer record directory.

Database Enrichment: For every unique buyer identified, cross-reference our files to gather their corporate profiles, standard delivery/shipping addresses, past item notes, and Uniform Sales Exemption certificates.

2. Lead Management and Inbox Organization

Inquiry Review: Review our corporate sales and informational inboxes for a 2-year window to identify and compile lists of prospects showing wholesale buying intent.

Lead Briefing Compilation: Use AI tools (such as Gemini or Claude) to summarize inbound lead data into concise, 3-sentence profiles detailing who the company is, what they want to buy, and indicators of their commercial volume capacity.

3. Compliance Audit

The Validation Pipeline: Verify contacts on our lists using a structured 3-step compliance framework:

Step 1: Search the official SERI database directory to find active R2 facility profiles and links.

Step 2: Scan historical internal communications for attached certificate documents or signature-line references.

Step 3: Use search engines and official corporate websites to verify compliance information online.

System Logging: Add clear, explicit compliance verification status notes (Confirmed R2, Confirmed Non-R2, or Unconfirmed/Pending) into our tracking spreadsheets and HubSpot fields.

4. CRM Architecture and SOP Documentation

Form and Property Infrastructure: Build custom data fields (Equipment Interests checkboxes and R2 Self-Claim dropdowns) and consolidate individual landing page links into a single, unified HubSpot capture form.

Legacy List Sorting Logic: Migrate legacy newsletter subscribers into our main database, retroactively tagging server list contacts for Servers only and general list contacts for All Equipment categories.

SOP Documentation: Write out clear step-by-step instructions and record short, screen-recorded visual walkthroughs (using Loom) documenting your lead intake and verification processes so the workflow can be reproduced by future hires.

Required Profile and Qualifications

Experience Tiers: Prior background tracking inventory or auditing contact data properties inside HubSpot and QuickBooks Online.

Technical Precision: Advanced proficiency with spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets), including data formatting and duplicate removal features.

Process Documentation: A demonstrated capability to map out a digital process clearly using written logs or simple screen recordings.

AI Literacy: Comfortable using LLM chat interfaces as an everyday tool to extract structured data tables from large blocks of unorganized text.

Communication: Excellent written and spoken English.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a 1-to-2 sentence summary highlighting your past experience sorting data tables or managing customer profiles inside a CRM platform.

title: Social Media & Podcast Manager (Video, US Real Estate Coaching Brand)
description:
**READ THIS PART FIRST**



To apply, start your message with the word BLUEPRINT. Applications without it are deleted unread. This is the first test of the job, which is following a system exactly.



**WHO WE ARE**



We are a US real estate coaching company and sales team based in Virginia. Our founder, Dan Rochon, is a TEDx speaker and the author of Teach to Sell, published by Post Hill Press and distributed by Simon & Schuster. He hosts the No Broke Months podcast.



Our promise to agents is CPI, which is Consistent and Predictable Income. Every real estate agent wants it, and most have no idea how to build it. We teach them. Dan has not had a broke month since 2008 using this system.



We have a book, a podcast, a coaching community, and real agents whose incomes are changing. All of it is under produced. That is the job.



**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**



You are not a posting assistant. You own attention for the whole brand.



- Social media across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube,
, and LinkedIn. Short form video first.

- The No Broke Months podcast, end to end. Guest scheduling, editing, publishing, show notes, clips.

- Turning one long form recording per week into a full set of short clips for every channel.

- Book marketing for Teach to Sell, including the Amazon and Audible review campaign.

- Telling our agents' stories. Their wins, their numbers, their transformations.

- A simple monthly report showing reach, views, opt ins, and applications, and what changed and why.



**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**



- Content ships on schedule every week without anyone reminding you.

- One recording becomes ten or more usable pieces.

- You can look at last month's numbers and tell us which three things to stop doing.

- Our agents become the story. Not the founder, and not you.



**YOU ARE A FIT IF**



- You have 2+ years running social media or content for a US or international brand, and you can show the accounts.

- You edit short form video yourself. CapCut, Premiere, Descript, or similar.

- You write English that sounds like a person, not like a template.

- You are organized enough to run a publishing calendar and never miss.

- You look at analytics on your own and change what you do because of them.

- You can work at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time.

- You have reliable internet and a backup plan when it fails.



**YOU ARE NOT A FIT IF**



- You need someone to send you a content calendar every week.

- You have never edited a video yourself.

- You want a quiet posting job. This seat is measured.



**HOW WE HIRE, AND WE ARE OPEN ABOUT IT**



Every application is scored by the same AI system our agents use, built on twenty years of top producer sales experience. Everyone gets the same read, the same bar, and a fast answer. No one gets ahead by charming a recruiter.



After the first review, qualified applicants complete a short skills audition. We test the work, not the resume:



Write three hooks for a video we give you.

Look at a post that failed and tell us why.

A simple 90 day plan for one channel.

A 60 to 90 second video of you talking to camera about your best piece of work.



Strong candidates then move to a paid two week trial before anyone commits long term. You will know if this is your seat, and so will we.



**TO APPLY**



Send a message that includes, in this order:



- The word BLUEPRINT at the top.

- Links to two or three accounts or channels you have run, and what you did on each.

- Two short form videos you edited yourself.

- Your monthly salary expectation in USD.

- One sentence: the best performing thing you ever made, and why you think it worked.



We read every application that follows these steps. We read none that do not.

title: Video editor
description:
I’m looking for a reliable video editor to edit my daily “Get Ready With Me” videos.



Each finished video will be no longer than approximately seven minutes. I record throughout the day, so the raw footage may contain multiple clips. I will also provide a prerecorded voice-over for the editor to add and synchronize with the footage.



Editing requirements:



* Review all footage and use the most interesting clips at the appropriate moments.

* Add my prerecorded voice-over and match the visuals to what I’m saying.

* Use the strongest sentence from my voice-over as the opening hook, even if it appears later in the recording.

* Do not automatically use the beginning of my footage or voice-over as the beginning of the finished video.

* Remove dead space, pauses, mistakes, and repetition.

* Add clear, readable captions that accurately match the voice-over.

* Use light zooms and clean cuts where appropriate.

* Balance the voice-over, original audio, and background music so everything is easy to hear.

* Turn simple or unpolished footage into an engaging video while keeping it natural and authentic.

* Avoid excessive effects or overediting.



My budget is $5–$8 per video, with an absolute maximum of $8 per video. This will be ongoing work, as I plan to post videos daily.



Please apply only if you are comfortable with the budget and can consistently deliver polished, engaging edits.

VII Energy Group is seeking a full-time Driver & Carrier Recruitment Specialist to support the growth of our U.S. transportation and logistics operations.



This is an outbound calling and recruiting position. Your primary responsibility will be identifying, contacting, qualifying, and developing relationships with owner-operators, carriers, and drivers interested in working with VII Energy Group.

This is not a passive lead-generation role. We are looking for someone comfortable spending a significant portion of the workday on the phone and consistently working a structured prospect list.

Responsibilities include:



Make a minimum of 100 outbound calls per day, with a target of 120+ calls per day, while maintaining required follow-up, documentation, call quality, and conversion standards.

Meet established activity, conversion, documentation, and performance standards.

As VII Energy Group expands its approved transportation services, this position will also support shipper and customer development by identifying prospective accounts, conducting outbound outreach, obtaining vendor/carrier onboarding requirements, assisting with approval packets, maintaining follow-up pipelines, and helping convert approved accounts into active shipping customers.



Requirements:



Applicants should have:

Prior U.S. transportation/trucking/logistics industry knowledge or experience.

Strong outbound calling, carrier recruitment, driver recruitment, telesales, or comparable phone-based experience.

Excellent spoken and written English.

Confidence communicating professionally with U.S.-based drivers, owner-operators, and carriers.

Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Outlook and basic SharePoint/document-management workflows.

Training & Compensation

This is a full-time, paid position. New hires will complete VII Energy Group's structured two-week intensive onboarding and role-training program while beginning supervised production activities.

Training includes company orientation, transportation fundamentals, driver/carrier recruitment, scripts, Microsoft 365 and SharePoint systems, documentation standards, compliance, security, call practice, live calling, conversion procedures, and performance coaching.



Training is not observational only. Candidates will be expected to demonstrate competency through exercises, assessments, call practice, supervised live work, and performance evaluation.

The position includes a base hourly wage plus performance-based compensation.

In addition to base pay, the employee will earn an established bonus or commission for qualifying carrier/driver conversions that successfully activate and result in a booked load, according to VII Energy Group's compensation structure.



Performance Expectations



We are building a performance-driven operation. Candidates should be comfortable with measurable standards including outbound call volume, quality of documentation, follow-up completion, qualified prospects, successful activations, and conversions.



Performance will be measured through the pipeline:



Outbound Calls ? Contacts ? Qualified Prospects ? Follow-Ups ? Signed/Approved Carriers ? Activated Carriers ? First Load Booked



Call volume alone does not constitute successful performance. Employees are expected to demonstrate both consistent activity and measurable conversion results while maintaining accurate records and professional communication.

$5.00 USD/hour + performance incentives



Under Training & Compensation:



Compensation: $5.00 USD/hour base pay plus performance-based incentives. Employees earn an additional $15 for each personally recruited driver/carrier who successfully completes onboarding and reaches their first qualifying booked load.

title: Cold Caller — Free Website Offer for Small Businesses (USA & UK)
description:
I build websites for small local businesses. The pitch is unusual and that

is why it works: **the business does not pay to see it.** I rebuild their

website, they get a working link, and only then do we talk about money.



Your job is the phone call that starts it. You call small businesses whose

current website is outdated and you ask one thing: may I send you a

rebuilt version of your website to look at, free, no obligation?



That is it. You are not closing a sale on that first call. You are getting

a yes and an
 address.



Markets are the **USA and the UK**. I handle Germany myself.



 What you will do



- Call small local businesses. Restaurants, pubs, cafés, salons, garages,

  electricians, roofers, landscapers.

- Ask whether they would like to see a free, rebuilt version of their

  website. No obligation, no payment, nothing to sign.

- If yes: get their *
 address**, the name of the person you spoke to,

  and anything they tell you about the business.

- **Tell me the moment someone says yes.** Not at the end of the day. I

  build the site and send it to that address **within 12 hours**.

- Follow up by phone a few days later, and again after two weeks.

- Close the sale when the owner is ready, and make sure the ongoing plan

  is on the table every single time. More on that below, because it is

  where most of your money is.

- Send me a short written update at the end of every working day: who you

  called, who said yes, who said no.



I will give you part of my lead list to start with, but finding your own

leads is part of the job. I will show you exactly how I find them.



What you are selling



Three ways, and the customer picks:



1. **One-off.** £449 in the UK, 499 EUR in Europe and 499$. The site is handed over

   and belongs to them.

2. **One-off plus hosting.** Same as above, and I look after the domain,

   hosting and updates for a small monthly fee.

3. **All-in monthly.** No payment up front, everything included, 24 month

   minimum term.



You do not need to memorise numbers. I give you the current prices for

each market and a script.



What you get



- **70 USD for every website that sells.**

- **On top of that, for every month the customer actually pays:**

  - **5 EUR** if they took the all-in monthly plan

  - **2 EUR** if they bought the site once and took hosting

- Paid monthly, for as long as that customer keeps paying, up to 24 months.



What that means in practice, per customer you close:



| What the customer takes | You earn |

| --- | --- |

| One-off only | about 60 EUR |

| One-off plus hosting | about 108 EUR over two years |

| All-in monthly | about 180 EUR over two years |



**This is deliberate.** Every route pays you roughly the same share, so

you can recommend whatever genuinely fits the business instead of

whatever pays you best. But the ongoing plans are worth two to three

times as much to you in total, so it is always worth asking.



- Everything is provided: leads, script, the websites, the
s. You

  never build or design anything.

- Long term. I am not looking for a campaign, I am looking for one person

  to work with.



**Read this carefully:** this is commission only. There is no base salary

and no payment per call. If you need a guaranteed monthly income, this

role is not for you, and I would rather you knew that now than in two

weeks.

 What I need from you



- **Excellent spoken English with a neutral accent.** You will be talking

  to a pub owner in Essex and to a garage owner in Ohio. If they have to

  concentrate to understand you, the call is over. This is the single most

  important requirement and I will assess it in a short voice call.

- Willingness to work their hours, not yours.** UK business hours are

  roughly 4 pm to 1 am Manila time. US East Coast is later still. You do

  not have to cover all of it, but you must be reliably available in a

  block that matches one of the two markets.

- Phone manner that survives rejection. Most calls end in no. The job is

  not persuasion, it is asking a fair question many times without going

  flat.

- Honesty in reporting. If a business said no, write no. Numbers I cannot

  trust are worse than no numbers.

- Reliable internet and a headset that does not crackle.



 What I do not need



- No design, no coding, no marketing courses.

- No agency and no team. One person.

- No hard selling. The first look is free. Anyone who has to be pushed at

  that stage will not stay a customer.



 How to apply



Send me a **voice recording of about sixty seconds** in English. In it:



1. Say who you are and where you have done phone work before.

2. Then, as if I were the owner of a small garage in England, make the

   call. Ask me whether I would like to see a free rebuilt version of my

   website.



Use your own words. I am not listening for a perfect script. I am

listening for how you sound and whether I would keep listening.



Applications without a voice recording I will not read.

title: Transportation Dispatcher — U.S. Trucking & Logistics
description:
Compensation

$6.00 USD/hour + performance incentives 

($6.00 USD/hour + $10–$15 per qualifying load based on performance and advancement tier)



VII Energy Group is seeking a full-time Transportation Dispatcher to support our growing U.S. transportation and logistics operations.



This position is responsible for managing assigned drivers, identifying and booking profitable freight, communicating with brokers and drivers, tracking shipments from pickup through delivery, and maintaining accurate documentation.

Prior U.S. trucking dispatch experience is required. Applicants should already understand U.S. trucking and freight dispatch. VII Energy Group provides training on our systems, procedures, compliance standards, and operating expectations.



Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.



**Responsibilities**



Manage assigned drivers and maintain professional communication throughout the dispatch process.

Search approved load boards for freight that meets driver, equipment, lane, and profitability requirements.

Evaluate loads based on rate, mileage, deadhead, rate per mile, location, and driver availability.

Negotiate with U.S.-based freight brokers and book approved loads.



Obtain rate confirmations and provide drivers with complete pickup, delivery, appointment, and load information.



Track loads from pickup through delivery and communicate delays, detention, accessorials, or other issues.



Collect and maintain required documentation, including rate confirmations, BOLs, PODs, and shipment records.



Accurately update assigned loads and driver activity in company systems.



Coordinate with recruitment/onboarding as newly approved drivers transition into active dispatch.



Participate in mandatory Monday and Thursday team meetings, coaching, and ongoing training.



Follow company procedures for security, confidentiality, documentation, compliance, and system access.



Requirements:



**Applicants should have**



Prior U.S. trucking/freight dispatch experience.

Experience using U.S. load boards and sourcing freight.

Knowledge of rate confirmations, BOLs, PODs, rate per mile, deadhead, detention, accessorials, pickup/delivery procedures, and load tracking.

Experience negotiating and communicating with U.S.-based freight brokers.

Ability to evaluate loads for driver compatibility and profitability.

Excellent spoken and written English.

Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Outlook and SharePoint.

Strong computer, data-entry, organization, and follow-up skills.

Ability to manage multiple drivers and active loads while maintaining accurate documentation.

Ability to follow structured SOPs, workflows, and compliance procedures.

Reliable computer, high-speed internet, and professional-quality headset.

Reliable availability for the complete U.S. Eastern Time schedule.

Willingness to complete an intensive two-week training and qualification program.

Willingness to provide a professional profile/headshot photograph for VII Energy Group's internal employee directory and company systems upon hire.



Training & Compensation:



This is a full-time, paid position.



New hires complete a structured two-week intensive onboarding and dispatcher training program covering VII Energy Group procedures, driver management, load selection, profitability, broker negotiation, documentation, Microsoft 365/SharePoint, compliance, security, shipment tracking, and load closeout.



Training includes assessments, load scenarios, negotiation practice, system exercises, and supervised dispatch activities. 



Candidates must successfully complete training before operating independently.



Starting compensation: $6.00 USD/hour plus performance-based load incentives.



Dispatchers may earn an additional $10–$15 per qualifying load, based on performance and advancement tier.



Performance Expectations:



Performance is measured by driver utilization, load quality, profitability, documentation accuracy, on-time performance, communication, compliance, and successful load completion.



The goal is to keep assigned drivers moving safely, efficiently, compliantly, and profitably.

description:
About the Role



Purple Cow Internet is on a mission to lower the cost of living for every home in the Maritimes by delivering

fast, affordable, no-nonsense internet. As our fiber network grows, we're looking for an Engineering Designer to

turn coverage plans into buildable fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) designs.

In this role you'll own the design of our outside-plant fiber network — from high-level route planning down to splice

level detail — producing the drawings, records, and bills of material our construction and splicing crews rely on.

You'll work independently on standard FTTH designs while collaborating with senior engineers, permitting, and field

teams to keep builds on time, on budget, and built to standard.



What You'll Do

Design fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) networks — feeder, distribution, and drop — using GPON/XGS-PON

architectures and standard optical budgets.

Plan fiber routes and calculate optical loss budgets, splitter placement, and split ratios to meet performance and

take-rate targets.

Produce construction-ready design packages: route maps, splice diagrams, fiber allocation schematics,

cabinet/enclosure layouts, and bills of material.

Create and maintain accurate network records and as-builts in GIS and CAD platforms.

Design both aerial (pole-based) and underground (conduit/directional-bore) plant, accounting for make-ready,

pole loading, and civil constraints.

Coordinate with pole owners, municipalities, and utilities on make-ready, permits, and joint-use agreements.

Perform field checks and verify survey data to ground designs in real-world conditions.

Support cost estimating and materials forecasting for planned builds.

Partner with construction and splicing crews to resolve field issues and feed lessons learned back into design

standards.

Help refine design standards, templates, and workflows as the network scales.



What You Bring

2–5 years of experience designing FTTH / fiber-optic outside-plant networks, or closely related telecom

infrastructure design.

Working knowledge of GPON/XGS-PON architecture, optical loss budgeting, splitters, and drop design.

Proficiency with CAD and/or GIS design tools (e.g., AutoCAD, QGIS/ArcGIS, or fiber design platforms such as

VETRO, IQGeo, or 3-GIS).

Solid understanding of aerial and underground construction methods, make-ready, and industry standards.

Ability to read and interpret survey data, maps, and construction prints.

Strong attention to detail and comfort managing multiple designs at once.

Clear communicator who works well with field crews, permitting bodies, and engineering peers.

Post-secondary diploma or degree in engineering technology, telecommunications, GIS, drafting, or equivalent

hands-on experience.

title: Credentialing & Insurance Contracting Specialist (Healthcare)
description:
Job Title: Credentialing & Insurance Contracting Specialist (Healthcare)



Location: Remote



Type: Contract or Part-Time (with potential for growth)



Company: Wings of the Future



Position Overview



We are seeking a highly experienced Credentialing & Insurance Contracting Specialist who can take full ownership of the end-to-end insurance setup process for a growing healthcare and mental health organization.



This is not a basic administrative role. We are looking for someone who understands the entire lifecycle of payer enrollment, contracting, and revenue cycle setup—and can execute independently with minimal oversight.



Key Responsibilities



You will be responsible for fully setting up and managing all insurance-related processes, including:



Credentialing & Enrollment



* Complete provider credentialing with commercial insurance panels and government payers (e.g., Medicaid, Medicare if applicable)

* Manage CAQH profile creation, updates, and attestations

* Submit and track applications from start to approval

* Ensure all provider information is accurate, compliant, and up to date



Insurance Contracting



* Initiate and negotiate insurance contracts (when applicable)

* Manage contract execution and documentation

* Track payer communications and follow-ups to completion



EDI / ERA / EFT Setup



* Set up EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) for claims submission

* Establish ERA (Electronic Remittance Advice) enrollment

* Set up EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer) for direct payments

* Coordinate with clearinghouses (e.g., Office Ally, Availity, Change Healthcare, etc.)

* Ensure systems are tested and fully operational



Systems & Billing Integration



* Collaborate with billing platforms and EHR systems to ensure proper configuration

* Verify claims flow from submission to payment

* Troubleshoot enrollment or payment issues



Compliance & Maintenance



* Maintain credentialing files and documentation

* Monitor re-credentialing deadlines

* Ensure compliance with payer requirements and industry standards



Qualifications



* Proven experience in medical credentialing and insurance contracting (REQUIRED)

* Strong working knowledge of:

    * CAQH

    * EDI / ERA / EFT processes

    * Insurance panel enrollment (commercial + government)

    * Clearinghouses and billing workflows

* Experience working with mental health providers, group practices, or healthcare organizations preferred

* Ability to manage multiple applications and follow-ups simultaneously

* Strong attention to detail and persistence with payer follow-ups

* Self-starter who can execute without hand-holding



What We’re Looking For



* Someone who doesn’t just “submit applications” but gets providers fully credentialed, connected, and paid

* Problem-solver mindset—you know how to navigate payer delays and obstacles

* Organized, proactive, and results-driven

* Comfortable working in a growing, mission-driven organization



About Us



Wings of the Future is a trauma-informed organization dedicated to helping individuals and families heal, grow, and build healthy, sustainable lives. We specialize in working with trauma-exposed professionals and underserved communities.



How to Apply



Please submit: 
 and 



* Your resume

* A brief summary of your experience with end-to-end credentialing and insurance setup

* Examples of systems or payers you’ve worked with in the past.

title: SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR & PAID SOCIAL CREATIVE - UK DRINKS BRAND (LONG-TERM)
description:
ABOUT US



We run Cocktail Week - city-wide cocktail festivals across more than 20 cities in the UK and Ireland, including Belfast, Liverpool, Manchester, Newcastle, Leeds, Cardiff, Dublin and Cork.



Each city has its own event and its own social media accounts. We sell wristbands that give people access to discounted cocktails across dozens of bars in their city.



We are looking for someone to own our short-form video and paid advertising creative. This is a long-term role with real ownership, not a one-off project.





IMPORTANT - PLEASE READ



You will not be filming our events. We have an archive of footage from previous years, content from influencers who attend our events, and stock footage. Your job is to turn that material into great short-form video.



We would also like you to shoot simple cocktail and bar footage yourself where you can - close-ups of pouring, ice, garnishes, glassware. Phone quality is fine. This kind of footage is useful to us and you can film it anywhere.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



SHORT-FORM VIDEO

- Edit Reels, TikToks and Stories from our archive, influencer content and stock footage

- Create city-specific versions of the same edit for 20+ cities, swapping logos, dates and links

- Add burned-in captions to every video

- Shoot simple cocktail and bar b-roll yourself to fill gaps



PAID ADVERTISING CREATIVE

- Produce multiple versions of each advert for testing - particularly different opening hooks

- Export in the formats we need (9:16, 4:5, 1:1)

- Produce static advert creative as well as video

- Follow advertising rules carefully (we will train you on these - they matter a lot in our industry)



SUPPORTING WORK

- Graphics for our
 campaigns

- Images for our website venue listings

- Keeping our content library organised and properly tagged





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- A portfolio of SHORT-FORM VERTICAL VIDEO. Please do not send corporate videos, weddings or long-form work - it is a different craft and not what we need.

- Strong editing skills in Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut or similar

- An understanding of what makes someone stop scrolling in the first 2 seconds

- Comfortable producing many variations of the same concept for testing, rather than one polished piece. A lot of this job is volume.

- Always adding captions - you understand that most people watch with the sound off

- Able to follow brand guidelines precisely - colours, fonts, logos

- Reliable and communicative. If something is unclear, ask.





NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience making creative for
 or Instagram ads

- Motion graphics and animated text

- Canva

- Basic photography or product filming

- Any experience with food, drink or hospitality brands





HOW TO APPLY



Please send us:



1. A link to your portfolio or showreel. We are specifically looking for vertical short-form video. If your portfolio is mostly long-form, please point us to the short-form work.



2. A short note (maximum 200 words) about your experience with short-form and advertising creative.



3. Start your message with the word GARNISH so we know you have read this properly.



4. Tell us what software you use and your available hours.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a paid trial task (paid $60) before we make any hiring decision. We will send you footage and a brief. We pay for the trial regardless of the outcome.



We are looking for someone long-term who can grow with us. If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant — Accounting, Ecommerce & Marketing
description:
?? **IMPORTANT: Do NOT apply if you do not have an accounting degree or hands-on Xero experience. We will not consider applications without these. Please save your time and ours.**



The Role



We're looking for a rare kind of person. You studied accounting because you're logical, detail-oriented, and love systems. But you've always had a creative side that doesn't get used enough in a traditional accounting role. You thrive on ticking off tasks, shipping things fast, and seeing the direct impact of your work. And secretly, you've always wanted to design something that makes brands stick out in a crowded market.



If that's you, we want to talk.



About Us



We run five business entities across three countries. MXTology is a premium ready-to-drink cocktail brand that reached the Grand Final of Gordon Ramsay's Food Stars Australia — that's a core asset we lean on hard. Aussie Floats makes inflatable products for the Australian summer market. Floral Image is a corporate florist doing B2B and B2C deliveries. We also operate Floral Image in the USA and Canada.



Between all five entities, we're managing complex multi-jurisdictional accounting, multiple revenue streams, and aggressive growth targets across Australia, the USA, and Canada.



What You'll Actually Do



**Your primary focus right now is bookkeeping and financial operations across all five entities.**



You'll manage Xero as the single source of truth. Your core responsibilities include:



- Reconcile accounts across all five entities — Australian, US, and Canadian businesses

- Ensure full compliance with Australian GST, payroll, and superannuation requirements under Australian law

- Manage BAS lodgements, payroll processing, and super contributions for Australian staff

- Navigate US and Canadian tax and accounting requirements for our North American entities

- Manage inventory costing and reconciliation across MXTology and Aussie Floats

- Maintain the accounting calendar and make sure nothing falls through the cracks



This is where your accounting degree matters most. You need to understand multi-jurisdictional compliance, not just bookkeeping mechanics.



**But here's the critical piece — we're actively automating the accounting side of the business.** 

We're integrating AI tools, automating reconciliation workflows, and building systems so that the repetitive bookkeeping work becomes more hands-off over time. This isn't theoretical. We're investing in this now.



What that means for you is simple: as the accounting side gets automated, you transition into what you actually want to do.



You'll own Shopify operations for MXTology and Aussie Floats — updating product pages, optimizing conversions, managing inventory feeds, integrating apps. We use Klaviyo across all three consumer-facing businesses, so you'll manage
 sequences, customer data, and campaign execution. We use no-code tools — Bubble, Google Apps Script, Zapier — so you're orchestrating, not coding.



And then there's the creative work. You'll design social media assets, write copy for campaigns, help us position our brands as premium and intentional in markets full of noise. As we automate the accounting, this becomes your primary focus.



You'll work alongside the founder day to day, who handles big-picture strategy and vision. You execute with precision and speed.



Who We're Looking For



**Non-negotiable requirements:**

- Accounting degree (Bachelor's in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent)

- Hands-on Xero experience (not just "familiar with" — you've actually reconciled accounts, coded transactions, and run reports)

- Strong written English

- Reliable internet connection



**Strongly preferred:**

- Multi-jurisdictional accounting experience (Australia, USA, Canada, or any combination)

- Understanding of Australian GST, payroll, and superannuation compliance

- Shopify and/or Klaviyo experience

- AI fluency — you actively use Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, or similar tools in your daily workflow

- Creative ability — you can design social media posts, marketing
s, or brand assets that look professional and on-brand (Canva proficiency is a plus)

- Experience with no-code tools (Bubble, Zapier, Google Apps Script)



**The kind of person who thrives here:**

- You're fast — you'd rather ship something good today than perfect next month

- You love ticking off tasks and clearing a to-do list

- You're creative enough to design a social post that stops the scroll, but disciplined enough to reconcile a multi-entity balance sheet without cutting corners

- You see this role as a pathway — the accounting work is stable income and the foundation, but you're excited about the creative and marketing side growing as we automate the bookkeeping

- You're building something with us, not just doing a job



The Offer



Full-time: 40 hours per week. Ongoing role with clear growth pathway.



**Months 1–3 (Probationary Period): AUD $12 per hour**

- Annual equivalent: AUD $23,040

- This period is about proving execution and fit

- You'll get familiar with our systems, three countries, five entities, and our automation roadmap



**Month 4+ (Confirmed Role): AUD $15 per hour**

- Annual equivalent: AUD $30,000

- Performance-based increase — you've proven yourself

- We're investing in your longevity and growth

- This is when we really start building out automation and you transition toward more creative work



You'll work directly with the founder day to day. We iterate fast. And as we build out automation, you're part of designing what that looks like and how your role evolves.



How to Apply



**?? To confirm you've read this entire ad, start your application with the word "FIREBALL". Applications that don't start with this word will not be reviewed.**



Then tell us:



1. **Your accounting qualifications** — what degree do you hold, and any certifications (Xero, CPA, etc.)?



2. **Your Xero experience** — how many years, what types of entities have you managed, and have you done any multi-jurisdictional work (Australia, USA, Canada, or other)?



3. **Your AI experience** — give us ONE specific example of how you've used AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) to complete a real work task faster or better. Be specific — generic answers like "I use ChatGPT sometimes" won't cut it.



4. **Your creative side** — show us ONE thing you've designed or created that you're proud of. A social media post, an
 campaign, a landing page, a brand asset — anything. Include a link or attach an image.



5. **Your availability** — confirm you can work 40 hours per week and let us know your timezone.



**All five questions must be answered in full. Incomplete applications will not be considered.**



We review applications within 48 hours. Shortlisted candidates will receive a short paid test task covering both a bookkeeping exercise and a Shopify/marketing execution task.



We move fast. If you're the right fit, you could be working with us within two weeks.





MXTology — Premium cocktails in a pouch. Grand Finalists on Gordon Ramsay's Food Stars Australia.

Aussie Floats — Inflatable fun for the Australian summer.

Floral Image — Corporate floristry for the ACT, Seattle and Vancouver

title: AI BDR / Autonomous Prospecting System Builder – GHL Integration
description:
We’re looking for an experienced AI automation / AI sales systems specialist to design and build an AI BDR for TintGard, an established window-tinting business in Brisbane, Australia.



This is not a chatbot project and not a basic cold
 automation.



We want a system that continuously finds sales opportunities across the internet, identifies buying signals, qualifies prospects, starts relevant conversations where appropriate, and feeds qualified opportunities into our existing GoHighLevel (GHL) system.



The system we want built



There are 3 core prospecting engines:



1. Live Buying-Signal Engine



Find people and businesses already showing intent online.



Examples:



* Asking for window-tinting recommendations

* Asking about heat, glare, privacy or security solutions

* Public
/social/community discussions

* Forums, Reddit and other publicly accessible sources

* Relevant recommendation/request posts

* Other online buying signals you recommend



The objective is to identify demand while the prospect is actively looking for a solution.



2. Commercial Trigger Engine



Identify businesses/properties that may need window film before they actively search for a supplier.



Potential triggers include:



* New businesses/openings

* Commercial leases

* Office/shop fit-outs

* Renovations/refurbishments

* New developments

* Development applications

* Construction projects

* Tenders

* Business relocations

* Property/facilities changes

* Other commercial triggers you can identify



The AI should determine whether the trigger represents a genuine TintGard opportunity.



3. B2B Prospecting Engine



Continuously identify businesses matching our ideal customer profiles.



Potential markets include:



* Property/facilities managers

* Commercial property

* Builders

* Offices

* Retail

* Schools

* Childcare

* Body corporates

* Medical/health facilities

* Other high-value commercial prospects



The system should identify the appropriate decision-maker rather than simply collecting generic business details.



Intelligence + sales layers



Once an opportunity is discovered, we want the system to:



Enrich - Qualify - Score - Personalise - GHL - Follow-up - Human handoff - Track revenue



This may include:



* Contact and decision-maker enrichment

* AI opportunity qualification

* Intent scoring

* Location/relevance filtering

* Estimated opportunity value

* Personalised outreach based on the actual trigger

* Automated follow-up

* AI-assisted conversations

* Hot-lead alerts

* Human handoff when appropriate

* Source attribution

* Tracking opportunities through quote/job/won stages

* Learning which prospecting sources actually generate revenue



We are also interested in website visitor/company intent identification if there is a reliable and compliant way to incorporate this.



Existing system



We already have GoHighLevel.



GHL will remain our central CRM, lead-management and follow-up platform. We are not looking to replace it.



Your role is to design and build the prospecting and intelligence layers around it.



We’re open to technologies such as Buska, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, n8n, Make, AI agents, data/enrichment services and other platforms.



However, we do not want an unnecessarily expensive stack of subscriptions.



We want the builder to recommend the architecture.



What we’re looking for



We’re particularly interested in someone who understands both:



AI/automation AND sales prospecting.



The objective isn’t to build impressive technology.



The objective is to autonomously discover opportunities that turn into quotes and revenue.



We also want the system designed around legitimate access to data and compliant outreach, without putting our social,
 or other platform accounts at unnecessary risk.



When applying



Please answer these questions:



1. Have you built an AI BDR, autonomous prospecting system or similar system before? Please show examples.

2. How would you architect the three prospecting engines above?

3. What tools would you use for each layer and why?

4. What can genuinely be automated and what should remain human?

5. How would you find live buying signals online?

6. How would you build the commercial trigger prospecting layer?

7. How would you integrate everything into our existing GHL?

8. What would you build first as an MVP to prove the system can generate real opportunities?

9. What would you charge to build the system?

10. Please estimate all ongoing monthly software/data costs separately.



Please don’t send a generic AI developer application.



I’d like to see how you would actually approach this system.

title: Customer Service & Operations Coordinator (Weekend)

Approximately **9:00 AM - 6:30 PM Eastern Time**



This is a live operations role. While your scheduled shift ends around 6:30 PM, our priority is ensuring customers are taken care of and operations are properly wrapped up. Some days you'll finish on time, while busier days may require staying a little later to complete active customer issues, deliveries, or important operational handoffs.



Weekend availability is required.

Throughout your shift, you'll serve as the central point of coordination between customers, drivers, dispatch, fulfillment, and our internal team. You'll help ensure orders move smoothly from purchase through delivery while providing excellent customer support every step of the way.

- Resolve customer concerns using company procedures and communication templates

- Monitor incoming Shopify orders throughout your shift

- Monitor shipping, courier, and local delivery status

- Assist with inventory updates and product availability

- Help maintain accurate product listings when needed

- Complete organized shift handoffs for any open orders or ongoing issues



---



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys keeping operations organized.



The ideal candidate:



- Has exceptional customer service skills

- Is extremely detail-oriented and organized

- Can confidently manage multiple priorities at once

- Communicates professionally with customers and teammates

- Takes ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do

- Remains calm under pressure

- Learns systems quickly and follows procedures consistently

- Understands the importance of accuracy and confidentiality

- Is dependable, responsive, and accountable



Although this isn't a management title, this role carries a high level of responsibility. You'll play a key part in coordinating weekend operations and helping ensure everything runs smoothly.



---



Qualifications



Required:



- Excellent written and verbal English

- Strong customer service experience

- Outstanding attention to detail

- Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

- Strong organizational and problem-solving skills

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

- Reliable computer and high-speed internet

- Availability every Saturday and Sunday during U.S. Eastern Time business hours



Preferred:



- Logistics, dispatch, or delivery coordination experience

- Shopify experience

- E-commerce operations experience

- Order fulfillment experience

- Experience supporting U.S.-based customers

- Experience working in a remote operations environment



---



This Role Is NOT For You If...



- You struggle to stay organized while managing multiple tasks.

- You frequently overlook small details.

- You need constant supervision or direction.

- You become overwhelmed in fast-paced environments.

- You prefer repetitive work with little responsibility.

- You stop working simply because the scheduled shift has ended while important customer or operational issues are still active.



---



Compensation



Compensation is based on experience, communication skills, customer service background, Shopify experience, operational experience, and overall fit.



---



How to Apply



To help us identify candidates who pay attention to detail, please begin your application with the word **"LOGISTICS."**

title: Senior Data Scientist — Monte Carlo Sports Prediction Engine (Python, Statistics)
description:
Australian sports-analytics company. We run a true native-joint Monte Carlo simulation engine — 100,000 correlated simulation paths per game — publishing daily player-prop and game-line predictions across WNBA, MLB and AFL, with NFL and NBA launching in September. The system already has automated calibration, closing-line-value tracking, Brier/reliability reporting and a fully graded public track record. We need a very senior data scientist to make it the most accurate engine in the market.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Audit our v3.8 engine end-to-end and put findings in writing

- Build and backtest the NFL model before launch (backtest-before-deploy is law here)

- Own the calibration loop: bias correction, confidence rescaling, category-level performance auditing

- Extend the prediction side: opponent positional-defence modelling, schedule/rest effects, correlation-aware exposure

- Explain everything in plain English to a non-technical founder



YOU MUST HAVE — WITH PROOF

- You have BUILT AND SHIPPED a probabilistic simulation or pricing model in sports betting, quant trading, bookmaking or similar. On our call you will walk through one such model end-to-end: data, joint structure, validation, real-world results, and one way it failed.

- Deep Monte Carlo + joint-distribution craft (copulas, hierarchical/Bayesian structures, correlated outcomes)

- Working fluency in calibration: Brier score, reliability curves, closing-line value, de-vigging

- Small-sample discipline — you know why a 10-2 streak usually means nothing

- Strong Python/NumPy; strong written English; AEST overlap



We screen hard against overclaiming: "my model hits 65%" without sample size, odds and CLV context ends the conversation.



PROCESS: CV review ? technical call ? short PAID trial task (1–3 hrs, no code, tests judgement) ? decision within the week.



TO APPLY: send (1) your CV and (2) one paragraph describing the most similar system you have personally built, including how you validated it. Applications without the paragraph will not be reviewed. Start your reply with the word JOINT so we know you read this.

description:
Remote | Full Time | EST/PST Time-zone



This role requires hands-on paid social experience with DTC ecommerce brands selling physical products. Please do not apply if you primarily have lead generation experience.



Lucyd is looking for an experienced Meta Media Buyer with a strong DTC ecommerce background to manage and scale paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts.



You’ll work closely with our Growth Strategists and Creative team to launch campaigns, analyze performance, identify opportunities, and make optimization decisions that drive profitable growth.

What You’ll Do



Build, launch, manage, and optimize Meta campaigns across multiple DTC ecommerce accounts.

Test and optimize creatives, audiences, placements, budgets, offers, and campaign structures.

Monitor performance and make data-driven decisions to improve efficiency, profitability, and scale.

Analyze key metrics including MER, aMER, CAC, bCAC, CPA, CPM, and ROAS.

Work closely with Creative teams on new concepts, hooks, messaging angles, offers, and testing opportunities.

Troubleshoot campaign delivery, tracking, attribution, and other platform-related issues.

Communicate performance, opportunities, and blockers clearly with internal teams and clients.

Participate in client calls and provide clear written performance updates when needed.



What We’re Looking For

Agency experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign structure, testing, scaling, and optimization.

Experience working with Shopify and/or WooCommerce brands.

Strong understanding of DTC ecommerce performance metrics and unit economics.

Ability to analyze creative performance and understand the drivers behind winning and losing campaigns.

Strong analytical skills and confidence making optimization decisions from performance data.

title: Luxury Lifestyle Content Researcher via Instagram
description:
I am looking for a detail-oriented Instagram VA / Content Researcher who can help me find and curate luxury lifestyle content for an Instagram profile.



The main responsibility will be researching Instagram and other approved sources, finding relevant visual content, evaluating it according to specific guidelines, organizing it, and preparing batches for review.



This is NOT a typical social media manager position. The main focus is content research, visual curation, and organization.



TARGET LIFESTYLE AND AESTHETIC



The profile represents the lifestyle of a sophisticated man approximately 30–35 years old.



All selected content should feel consistent with this demographic and lifestyle.



The content should look natural and spontaneous, as if it was casually captured by a person using an iPhone during everyday life.



IMPORTANT:



The content should NOT look like professional photography, a commercial campaign, a fashion photoshoot, stock photography, or highly produced influencer content.



Preferred characteristics:



– Natural iPhone photography

– Natural lighting

– Casual framing

– Candid moments

– First-person / POV perspective

– Faceless lifestyle content

– Realistic everyday situations

– Understated luxury

– Authentic-looking environments

– Minimal editing

– Natural imperfections



The goal is not simply to find expensive-looking photos.



The goal is to find content that looks like a real moment from the life of a successful man in his early 30s.



MAIN CONTENT CATEGORIES



TRAVEL AND AVIATION



– Private jets

– Business class

– First class

– Airport lounges

– Luxury airports

– Airplane interiors

– Airplane window views

– Luggage

– Private aviation



YACHTS AND BOATS



– Luxury yachts

– Yacht decks

– Marinas

– Sailing

– Boat interiors

– Sunset on a yacht

– POV yacht content

– Beach clubs

– Boat trips



CARS



– Luxury cars

– Supercars

– Premium SUVs

– Car interiors

– Steering wheel POV

– Driving

– Parking at luxury locations

– Car keys

– Casual car content



HOTELS AND REAL ESTATE



– Luxury hotels

– Hotel rooms

– Hotel bathrooms

– Hotel breakfasts

– Hotel balconies

– Hotel pools

– Luxury villas

– Luxury apartments

– Rooftop views

– Hotel corridors and common areas



RESTAURANTS AND NIGHTLIFE



– High-end restaurants

– Restaurant tables

– Dinner

– Cocktails

– Rooftop bars

– Beach clubs

– Nightlife

– Luxury dining

– Casual evening situations



FASHION AND PERSONAL ITEMS



– Watches

– Shoes

– Sunglasses

– Tailored clothing

– Luggage

– Accessories

– Premium everyday items

– Understated luxury products



FITNESS AND WELLNESS



– Premium gyms

– Hotel gyms

– Fitness clubs

– Spas

– Wellness

– Yoga

– Stretching

– Swimming pools

– Post-workout lifestyle



LUXURY DESTINATIONS



– Monaco

– Dubai

– Ibiza

– Mykonos

– St. Tropez

– Cannes

– Milan

– Paris

– London

– Singapore

– Tokyo

– Maldives

– Bali

– Amalfi Coast

– Lake Como

– French Riviera

– Greek Islands



POV / FACELESS CONTENT



This is one of the most important categories.



Examples include:



– Hands

– Wrist and watch

– Feet

– Restaurant table

– Coffee

– Hotel breakfast

– Airplane window

– Yacht deck

– Car interior

– Steering wheel

– Hotel room

– Hotel balcony

– Pool

– Beach

– Gym equipment

– Suitcase

– Airport lounge

– City views

– Dinner table

– First-person travel experiences



EVERYDAY LUXURY



Do not focus only on obvious displays of wealth.



Natural everyday moments are especially valuable.



Examples:



– Coffee in a luxury hotel

– Breakfast

– Laptop on a hotel desk

– Hotel room

– Hotel hallway

– Elevator

– Suitcase

– Airport lounge

– Restaurant table

– Car interior

– City view

– Gym

– Balcony

– Casual evening drink

– Walking through a luxury location



The environment should communicate the lifestyle without the image trying too hard to show wealth.



LIFESTYLE CONTINUITY



When researching content, think about how several pieces could work together as one story.



For example:



Morning:

Hotel room -> Coffee -> Gym -> Breakfast



Afternoon:

Car -> Restaurant -> Marina -> Yacht



Evening:

Sunset -> Cocktail -> Dinner -> Hotel



It is highly valuable to find several pieces of content that can logically belong together.



Avoid random combinations of completely unrelated locations.



CONTENT VARIETY



Do not submit large batches consisting of only one type of content.



For example, do not submit 20 yacht photos or 20 supercar photos.



The content should be balanced across:



– Travel

– Hotels

– Restaurants

– Cars

– Aviation

– Yachts

– Fitness

– Fashion

– Everyday lifestyle

– POV

– Faceless content

– Luxury locations



CONTENT RESEARCH



Instagram will be one of the main research platforms.



Use:



– Instagram profiles

– Instagram Stories

– Instagram Reels

– Instagram location pages

– Geotags

– Relevant hashtags

– Hotels

– Restaurants

– Marinas

– Airports

– Luxury venues

– Travel destinations

– Lifestyle creators



Look beyond major influencers and professional photographers.



Smaller creators and ordinary users can often provide much more natural-looking content.



CONTENT SELECTION CRITERIA



Before selecting any piece of content, ask:



Does it look natural?

Does it look like it could have been captured casually on an iPhone?

Does it fit the lifestyle of a man approximately 30–35 years old?

Does it feel sophisticated and understated?

Does it look like a real-life moment rather than a professional photoshoot?

Does it fit the overall visual identity?

Could it logically fit together with other content?

Is the quality good enough for Instagram?

Is the source and intended use appropriate?

Would this look believable next to the rest of the profile?



If the answer to several of these questions is NO, do not submit the content.



CONTENT TRACKING AND ORGANIZATION



You will be responsible for keeping an accurate record of the researched content and saving selected material according to the approved format.



Each piece of content should be properly categorized and associated with the relevant source, location, content type, and usage status.



The system should make it easy to identify:



– Source

– Location

– Category

– Content type

– Review status

– Usage status

– Permission / usage status



DAILY WORKFLOW



Research Instagram and other approved sources.

Find relevant profiles and content.

Select the strongest pieces.

Evaluate them according to the aesthetic requirements.

Check that the content fits the target male lifestyle.

Check that it feels natural rather than professionally produced.

Check the source and usage status.

Save the selected content according to the approved format.

Keep the content record updated.

Submit a batch for review.

Apply feedback to future research.



TEST TASK



Before hiring, candidates will complete a test assignment.



The test assignment is to find 20 pieces of Instagram content that fit all requirements described above.



The 20 pieces should demonstrate variety.



A good test batch would include:



– 2-3 photos of a guy of a specified body type on the luxuty yacht / business jet / first class flight / near luxury car. That person should not be a famous profile.

– 1-2 hotel / lifestyle pieces

– 1-2 travel / aviation pieces

– 1-2 cars

– 1-2 restaurants / nightlife

– 1-2 yachts / beach / marina pieces

– Additional pieces from other relevant luxury lifestyle categories



The exact distribution is not important. Overall quality, variety, and consistency are more important.



The test will be evaluated based on:



– Quality of research

– Ability to find non-obvious content

– Natural iPhone-like aesthetic

– Understanding of the target demographic

– Consistency

– Attention to detail

– Ability to distinguish authentic-looking lifestyle content from staged content

– Organization

– Source and usage awareness



IDEAL CANDIDATE



You should:



– Use Instagram extensively

– Understand Instagram aesthetics

– Have a strong eye for visual quality

– Understand luxury lifestyle content

– Be comfortable researching locations and profiles

– Have excellent attention to detail

– Be able to work independently

– Communicate clearly in English

– Be comfortable working with Google Drive and similar tools

– Be reliable and consistent

– Be able to follow detailed visual guidelines



Previous experience as an Instagram VA, content researcher, social media VA, influencer VA, or content curator is a plus.



IMPORTANT



I am NOT looking for someone who simply searches for "luxury lifestyle" and selects the first attractive images.



I am looking for someone who can curate a consistent and believable visual world.



The key skill is understanding the difference between:



"This is an expensive-looking photo."



AND



"This looks like a real moment from the life of a successful man in his early 30s."



The second type of content is what we are looking for.
