title: SEO SPECIALIST - HOSPITALITY & LOCAL SEARCH - UK EVENTS BRAND (LONG-TERM)
description:
ABOUT US



We run Cocktail Week - city-wide cocktail festivals across more than 20 cities in the UK and Ireland, including Belfast, Liverpool, Manchester, Newcastle, Leeds, Cardiff, Dublin and Cork.



We sell wristbands that give people access to discounted cocktails across dozens of partner bars in their city. Our website runs on WordPress, and we work with over 500 partner venues.





THE CHALLENGE (please read - this shapes the whole role)



Our event names are only searched for about six weeks a year. "Belfast Cocktail Week" is busy in October and almost silent in March.



So the job is not just ranking for our event names. It is building content that ranks all year round for the things people in our cities actually search for - the best cocktail bars in Liverpool, where to drink in Newcastle, things to do in Belfast this weekend - and turning that traffic into people on our mailing list who buy tickets when our events come round.



If that sounds like the kind of problem you enjoy, we would like to hear from you.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



TECHNICAL FOUNDATIONS

- Full technical audit of our website and a prioritised plan to fix what matters

- Help us sort out our domain structure (we own a lot of city domains and need a proper strategy for them)

- Add event structured data across all our city and event pages

- Fix page titles, meta descriptions, heading structure and image alt text across our city and venue pages



CONTENT AND KEYWORDS

- Keyword research for each of our cities, covering both year-round and seasonal search

- Brief and optimise our city cocktail bar guides

- Optimise our venue listing pages (we have 500+)

- Plan seasonal content far enough ahead that it ranks in time



LOCAL SEO AND LINKS

- Run a link programme with our partner venues - they are real businesses in the cities we want to rank in, and most of them would happily link to us if asked properly

- Keep our local listings and citations accurate and consistent

- Track how we rank against local competitors in each city



REPORTING

- Set up and maintain Google Search Console and GA4 properly

- Track rankings by city and keyword group

- Monthly reporting that connects rankings to traffic to mailing list sign-ups





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Real hands-on SEO experience. Not theory - sites you have actually worked on and can talk about.

- Experience with LOCAL SEO. Understanding how the map pack works and how it differs from normal organic ranking.

- Experience in HOSPITALITY is strongly preferred - bars, restaurants, hotels, venues, events or tourism. This sector behaves differently from ecommerce and we would rather not teach it.

- Comfortable with technical SEO - crawling, redirects, schema markup, site speed

- Confident with Google Search Console, GA4 and a keyword tool such as Ahrefs or Semrush

- WordPress experience

- Able to explain your reasoning clearly in writing, including when you disagree with us

- Honest about what SEO can and cannot do, and how long it takes





NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience with event or ticketing websites

- Experience with multi-location or multi-city businesses

- Schema markup and structured data

- Any view on how AI search assistants are changing search, and what to do about it





HOW TO APPLY



Please send us:



1. Two or three examples of sites you have worked on, with a short note on what you did and what changed as a result. Please include real numbers if you can.



2. Start your message with the word BITTERS so we know you have read this properly.



3. Answer this in a few sentences: we own both 
 and 
, as well as several other similar domains for each of our cities. Our main website is 
. What would you do with the other domains, and why?



4. Your available hours and which SEO tools you have access to.



Please note: we are not interested in guaranteed rankings, backlink packages or anything similar. We are looking for someone who works properly and explains their thinking.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a paid trial task before we make any hiring decision. We pay for the trial regardless of the outcome.



This is a long-term role. SEO takes time and we understand that - we are looking for someone who will still be with us in two years.

title: Freelance SEO Manager
description:
Hours: 5 to 10 per week

 

We are seeking a strategic and detail-oriented **Freelance SEO Manager** to lead our organic growth efforts. This role is designed for an expert who can maximize impact within a focused 5–10 hour weekly window, prioritizing high-leverage actions that improve search visibility, domain authority, and organic conversions.

 

---

 

### Key Responsibilities

 

#### 1. Strategic SEO Planning

 

* **Audit & Strategy:** Conduct regular site audits to identify technical issues, content gaps, and on-page opportunities.

* **Keyword Intelligence:** Perform deep keyword research to identify high-intent search terms that align with our business goals.

 

#### 2. On-Page & Technical SEO

 

* **Content Optimization:** Optimize existing blog posts, product pages, and landing pages (metadata, headers, internal linking, and keyword density).

* **Technical Health:** Monitor and improve site speed, mobile-friendliness, crawlability, and indexing issues via Google Search Console.

* **Schema Markup:** Implement or guide the implementation of structured data to enhance SERP presence.

 

#### 3. Off-Page & Authority Building

 

* **Link Building Strategy:** Develop and oversee a sustainable backlink strategy through outreach, guest posting, or PR-driven opportunities.

* **Competitor Analysis:** Keep a pulse on competitor movements and market trends to ensure we maintain a competitive edge in the SERPs.

 

#### 4. Monitoring & Reporting

 

* **Performance Tracking:** Maintain a monthly dashboard tracking organic traffic, keyword rankings, and conversions using GA4 and Google Search Console.

* **Actionable Insights:** Translate complex data into clear, concise updates and recommendations for the team.

 

---

 

### Skills & Qualifications

 

* **Experience:** 4+ years of experience in SEO with a track record of ranking pages on the first page of Google.

* **Tool Mastery:** Advanced proficiency with SEO tools (e.g., Ahrefs, Semrush, or Moz) and Google’s suite (GA4, GSC, Looker Studio).

* **Technical Knowledge:** Understanding of HTML/CSS as it relates to SEO and experience with CMS platforms, such as Wordpress.

* **Content Proficiency:** Ability to provide clear editorial briefs for writers that balance "writing for humans" with "optimizing for bots."

* **Efficiency:** Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks that deliver the highest ROI within a part-time capacity.

 

---

 

### Why This Role?

 

* **Flexible Engagement:** Work from anywhere on a schedule that fits your freelance portfolio.

* **Strategic Ownership:** You will have the "keys" to our organic strategy and the freedom to implement best practices.

* **Long-Term Partnership:** We are looking for a consistent partner who understands our brand and grows with us.

 

---

 

### How to Apply

 

Please share a brief case study or example of a site you’ve successfully ranked, your hourly rate, and your preferred SEO toolset.

title: WordPress Malware Removal & Website Security Specialist — Immediate Need
description:
## Job Title



**WordPress Malware Removal & Website Security Specialist — Immediate Need**



## Job Description



We are a U.S.-based digital marketing and web development company looking for an experienced **WordPress security specialist** to help us investigate and remediate suspected hacking across multiple client websites.



This is a defensive website-security role. We need someone who can do more than install a security plugin. You must be able to identify how a site was compromised, locate hidden malware and backdoors, safely clean the website, and prevent the problem from returning.



Our immediate need is to audit a group of WordPress websites, determine which sites are compromised, clean any infected sites, and provide clear documentation of the evidence and work completed. This may become an ongoing position for the right person.



## Responsibilities



* Audit WordPress websites for malware, injected code, redirects, spam pages, backdoors, unauthorized administrators, and altered files.

* Determine whether each site is hacked, clean, or inconclusive.

* Identify the likely point of entry whenever possible.

* Remove malware without damaging the website or losing legitimate content.

* Inspect WordPress core files, themes, plugins, databases, uploads, cron jobs, user accounts, and server files.

* Review server logs, file changes, DNS records, redirects, and security warnings.

* Find hidden or recurring backdoors that may survive a basic malware cleanup.

* Compare infected files against clean WordPress, plugin, and theme versions.

* Restore clean files or backups when appropriate.

* Update and harden WordPress installations after cleanup.

* Configure or review Sucuri WAF and other website-security protections.

* Check whether multiple compromised websites are connected to the same server, user account, plugin, theme, or vulnerability.

* Document the evidence found on every website, including screenshots, file paths, malicious code, dates, and recommended next steps.

* Provide a concise written report that a nontechnical business owner can understand.

* Work carefully with backups and staging environments before making major changes.

* Communicate immediately when a compromised website presents a risk to other websites or servers.



## Required Experience



You must have real, hands-on experience with:



* WordPress malware investigation and removal

* PHP and JavaScript malware

* Malicious database injections

* Hidden administrator accounts and credential compromises

* Backdoors, web shells, redirects, SEO spam, and phishing pages

* WordPress core, plugin, and theme vulnerabilities

* SSH, SFTP, cPanel, phpMyAdmin, MySQL, and server logs

* DNS, A records, nameservers, SSL certificates, and website firewalls

* Sucuri or comparable website-security platforms

* Website backups, restoration, and post-cleanup testing

* WordPress security hardening

* Managing security work across multiple websites



Experience with **MainWP, dedicated servers, website migrations, Cloudflare, Linux servers, or hosting-company i
 response** is strongly preferred.



## What We Are Not Looking For



* Someone whose only solution is installing Wordfence or another plugin

* A general WordPress designer with limited security experience

* An agency that will rotate different people through the account

* An intern or entry-level developer

* Anyone performing offensive, unauthorized, or illegal hacking activities



We want **one consistent, experienced individual** who will personally perform the work.



## Work Process



* Work will be assigned and documented through Basecamp.

* Time must be accurately tracked.

* Website access will normally be provided through our approved systems, including MainWP when appropriate.

* You must follow strict confidentiality and access-control requirements.

* You may not copy, retain, or share client files, credentials, databases, or personal information.

* Payment will be made through 
 to the individual performing the work, not to an agency.

* Some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time will be required for communication and urgent i
.



## To Apply



Please answer all of the following. Applications without complete answers will not be considered.



1. How many years have you worked specifically on WordPress malware removal and website security?

2. Describe the most difficult WordPress compromise you personally investigated and cleaned.

3. How do you determine whether malware has created a persistent backdoor?

4. What areas of a WordPress installation do you inspect besides plugin and theme files?

5. How do you determine the likely point of entry?

6. What steps do you take before cleaning a live website?

7. What steps do you take after the malware has been removed?

8. What experience do you have with Sucuri WAF?

9. Are you comfortable using SSH, reviewing logs, and examining MySQL databases?

10. Are you an individual freelancer or part of an agency?

11. What hours can you overlap with U.S. Eastern Time?

12. What is your requested hourly rate?

13. How soon can you begin?

14. Provide an example of a security or malware-removal report you created. Remove all confidential client information before sending it.



At the beginning of your application, include the words:



**“I FIND THE ENTRY POINT”**



This confirms that you read the entire job description.



## Paid Skills Test



Final candidates may be given a paid test involving a WordPress website or sanitized website files. The test may require the candidate to:



* Identify signs of compromise

* Locate suspicious files or database records

* Explain the likely method of entry

* Recommend a safe cleanup procedure

* Prepare a short evidence-based report



Do not apply unless you are comfortable documenting exactly what you found and how you reached your conclusion.

title: Junior SEO Specialist – Experienced / Strategic - Please answer questions below when applying.
description:
Please answer questions below when applying. 



We are looking for an **experienced Junior SEO Specialist** who understands SEO beyond simply completing monthly tasks.



You should be able to analyse a website, understand its commercial objectives, identify ranking opportunities and explain **what actions you would take to improve organic performance and why**.



This role is suited to someone who already has hands-on SEO experience and wants to continue developing their strategic capabilities.



## What We're Looking For



You should have practical experience across:



* Keyword research and keyword mapping

* Commercial keyword intent

* **BOFU (Bottom-of-Funnel) keyword strategy**

* On-page SEO

* Technical SEO fundamentals

* Service and location page optimisation

* Content strategy and optimisation

* Internal linking and website architecture

* Competitor and SERP analysis

* Link building and authority development

* Google Search Console

* GA4

* Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar SEO tools

* Tracking keyword rankings, organic traffic and conversions



## Commercial SEO Understanding



A major part of this role is understanding that **not every keyword has the same commercial value**.



You should understand the difference between:



**Informational keywords** — users researching or learning about a topic.



**Commercial / BOFU keywords** — users actively searching for a service, product or provider and are much closer to converting.



You should be able to look at a business and determine:



**Which keywords are most likely to generate actual enquiries and revenue?**



We want someone who can prioritise SEO opportunities based on **commercial impact**, not simply search volume.



## Strategic SEO Thinking



If you're given a website that isn't performing, you should be able to investigate:



* What is currently ranking?

* What isn't ranking?

* Which keywords should the business be targeting?

* What are competitors doing better?

* Does the website properly match search intent?

* Are the correct pages targeting the correct keywords?

* Are there content gaps?

* Are pages competing against each other?

* Are there technical problems?

* Is the internal linking structure strong enough?

* Does the website have enough authority?

* What actions should be prioritised first?



Most importantly, you should be able to explain **why you would take each action**.



## Interview Requirement – Show Us Two Websites



As part of the interview, we will ask you to present **two websites you have personally worked on and helped improve through SEO**.



For each website, be prepared to explain:



### 1. Where It Started



What was the website's organic position when you became involved?



What were the main problems you identified?



### 2. Keyword Strategy



What keywords did you target?



Which keywords had the strongest commercial intent?



Which were **BOFU keywords** and why were they important to the business?



### 3. What You Actually Did



Walk us through the actions you personally took.



For example:



* Keyword research

* Keyword mapping

* Service page optimisation

* Creation of new landing pages

* Content improvements

* Technical fixes

* Internal linking

* Site structure improvements

* Competitor gap analysis

* Link building

* Outreach

* Backlink acquisition



Don't simply tell us what was done — **explain why you d
 to do it.**



### 4. What Happened Over 3–6 Months?



Show us the impact your work had.



Where possible, demonstrate:



* Starting keyword positions

* Current keyword positions

* Movement into Page 1 / Top 10

* Top 3 rankings

* Organic traffic growth

* Search Console improvements

* Organic conversions or enquiries

* Improvements in commercially valuable keywords



We want to understand the journey:



**Starting Position ? Analysis ? Strategy ? Actions ? Ranking Improvement**



## Example of the Thinking We're Looking For



Rather than:



*"We wrote blogs, optimised pages and built backlinks."*



We want someone who can explain:



*"The website was ranking around position 15 for an important commercial keyword. After reviewing the SERP and competitors, I identified that the service page didn't properly satisfy search intent and lacked supporting authority.*



*I improved the page structure and content, strengthened internal links from relevant pages, addressed technical/on-page issues and built relevant backlinks to the page.*



*Over the following 3–6 months, the keyword moved onto Page 1 and organic enquiries increased."*



That shows us you understand **what happened, why you took action and how those actions contributed to the result.**



## What Success Looks Like



You don't need to know everything, but you must be able to **think strategically about SEO**.



We're looking for someone who can demonstrate:



**Commercial Intent ? Opportunity ? Strategy ? Action ? Result**



You should be curious, analytical and comfortable investigating why a website isn't ranking rather than simply following an SEO checklist.



### To Apply



Please provide **two websites you have personally worked on and helped rank**.



For each website, briefly include:



* The website

* Your involvement

* Important keywords targeted

* What you changed

* How long you worked on it

* Results achieved within approximately 3–6 months



Shortlisted candidates should be prepared to discuss these examples in detail during the interview.

title: Ecommerce Media Buyer | Amazon, Google & Meta Ads
description:
About the Role



Seller Fuel (dba Toy Launch) is looking for an experienced Media Buyer to join our growing team.



You'll plan, launch, and optimize paid media campaigns across ecommerce channels, driving profitable growth for our toy & game brand clients.



We live by FUN, UPBEAT, EFFICIENT, and LIMITLESS. You'll see that in how we work and how we treat every client's ad spend like it's our own.



This role is for someone who thrives on data, knows how to turn ad spend into revenue, and wants ownership over real campaigns from day one.

Ready to put your media buying skills to work for brands that actually matter? Apply now.

title: Executive Operations & Business Growth Manager
description:
This Is Not Your Typical Virtual Assistant Role



We are not looking for someone who simply completes tasks.



We are looking for someone who thinks like a business owner — someone who sees inefficiencies, identifies opportunities, solves problems and constantly looks for ways to make a business more efficient, scalable and profitable.



You should naturally ask:

“Is there a better way to do this?”

“Can this be automated?”

“Can AI do this?”

“How can we scale this without simply adding more people?”



If that sounds like you, please keep reading.



About Us

We are a growing UK-based property company specializing in short-term accommodation.

As we grow, we are continually improving our systems, processes and technology. We are looking for an Executive Operations & Business Growth Manager to work closely with the founder and help take the business to its next stage.



This is a role for someone who wants responsibility, ownership and the opportunity to genuinely influence how a business operates and grows.



The Role

Your role will combine business operations, process improvement, project management, AI and automation.



You will be expected to:

- Help oversee and improve daily business operations

- Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks and areas for improvement

- Develop and improve systems, workflows and SOPs

- Research and implement software and technology

- Manage projects from idea through to completion

- Coordinate team members and ensure accountability

- Research new business opportunities

- Find ways to reduce unnecessary work and costs

- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive processes

- Use AI to improve productivity, decision-making and business operations

- Help build systems that allow the business to scale without increasing workload at the same rate



We don't want someone who simply tells us what is wrong.

We want someone who can say:



“Here is the problem, here is what I recommend, here is how we can implement it, and here is how we can measure whether it worked.”



AI & Automation

AI will be a major part of this role.



You do not need to be a developer, but you should have strong practical knowledge of modern AI tools and understand how they can be applied within a real business.



We want someone who can use AI to:

- Automate repetitive work

- Improve workflows

- Analyse information and data

- Research opportunities

- Create systems and documentation

- Improve communication

- Reduce administrative workload

- Identify opportunities for further automation



We are particularly interested in someone who understands how to integrate AI into business processes, rather than someone who simply knows how to use ChatGPT.



Please include “Always Improving” at the very top of your application so we know you have read the advert carefully.



The Person We Are Looking For



You are someone who:

- Thinks commercially and strategically

- Takes ownership without needing constant direction

- Understands how businesses can scale

- Has strong operations experience

- Loves solving problems

- Is highly organised and analytical

- Thinks ahead and anticipates problems

- Is confident researching and implementing new technology

- Has strong practical AI knowledge

- Looks for opportunities to automate and improve

- Can challenge inefficient processes constructively

- Communicates exceptionally well

- Turns ideas into action



Most importantly, you don't just ask what needs to be done — you ask whether there is a better way to do it.



Essential Requirements

- Minimum 3 years' experience in operations, business management, project management, executive support or similar

- Strong understanding of business operations and process improvement

- Demonstrated ability to improve systems or workflows

- Strong practical knowledge of AI tools

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Strong organisational and project management skills

- Experience with Google Workspace and project management software

- Ability to work independently and take ownership

- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

- Reliable internet connection and quiet home office



Bonus Experience

Experience with AI automation, AI agents, property/hospitality, Airbnb, Hostfully, PriceLabs, team leadership, SOP development or business scaling is highly advantageous.



Salary

Competitive and based on experience.



We are looking for the right person, not simply the lowest hourly rate.

Exceptional performance will be recognised through increased responsibility, salary increases and performance-based bonuses.



Application Questions

Please answer these with specific examples, rather than generic answers.

1. Tell us about a process you improved. What was wrong with it, what did you change, and what was the result?

2. Tell us about a time you identified a problem or opportunity before anyone else noticed it. What did you do?

3. Which AI tools do you currently use? Give us a specific example of how you have used AI to save time, automate work or improve a business process.

4. Imagine you discover that a team is spending 10 hours every week doing a repetitive manual task. How would you approach finding a better solution?

5. If you joined our business tomorrow, what would you want to understand or analyse during your first 30 days?

6. Why do you believe you would be good at helping a business scale and continuously improve, rather than simply managing its existing operations?



Video

Please record a 2–3 minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be an excellent fit for this role.



Please note: Applications that do not meet the essential requirements outlined above, including the required 2–3 minute video introduction, may not be considered for the next stage of the recruitment process. We encourage you to apply only if your experience, skills and approach closely align with what we are looking for.

title: Video Editor (Social First) - Philippines
description:
The Role

Neutonic is looking for a talented, creatively driven Video Editor (Social First) to join our growing in-house content team.



This role is for someone who understands that great editing is about more than making something look good. It’s about grabbing attention, holding it, telling a story quickly and creating content that feels native to the platform it lives on.



You’ll work closely with our Senior Social Media Manager, supporting the day-to-day creation and development of content across Neutonic’s organic social, paid creative, UGC, retail and wider brand campaigns. You’ll play an important role in increasing the volume, variety and quality of content we produce as the brand continues to grow.



We’re looking for someone who is genuinely social-first in their thinking. You should understand hooks, pacing, retention, storytelling and what makes people stop scrolling. You’ll be comfortable taking raw footage, UGC, founder content or campaign assets and turning them into multiple strong executions rather than simply producing one finished edit.



Ideally, you’ll also have experience working with beverage, FMCG or consumer brands, with an understanding of how to make physical products feel exciting, relevant and native to social.



This is a hands-on role with plenty of opportunity to contribute beyond editing. You’ll work on concepts, hooks, campaign ideas and new content formats as we continue to diversify Neutonic’s creative and build out our internal content capabilities.



What you’ll do

- Work closely with the Senior Social Media Manager to develop and deliver Neutonic’s social-first video output

- Edit high-quality content across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Meta and other digital channels

- Turn raw footage, UGC, campaign content and founder-led content into engaging short-form edits

- Create multiple hooks, versions, cut-downs and creative variations from existing footage

- Edit content for organic social, paid social and performance creative

- Apply strong social-first principles around hooks, pacing, retention and storytelling

- Add motion graphics, text animation, captions, sound design and other creative treatments where appropriate

- Repurpose content across social, paid media, retail, web,
 and wider marketing channels

- Contribute to new concepts, formats, recurring content series and campaign ideas

- Maximise the output from shoots by identifying multiple pieces of content from each setup or piece of footage

- Stay close to emerging social formats, editing styles, trends and platform behaviours

- Use performance insights to continually improve edits and test new creative approaches

- Organise and manage video projects and assets so content can be efficiently reused and adapted

- Help develop scalable editing templates and workflows as Neutonic’s content output grows

- Collaborate with the wider creative, marketing, retail and growth teams where required



Who you are

- 2–4+ years of professional video editing experience, ideally within a social-first brand, agency or content environment

- A strong portfolio demonstrating short-form, social-first editing

- Experience working with beverage, drinks, FMCG or consumer brands is highly desirable

- Highly proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro, with experience using After Effects and other Adobe Creative Suite tools

- Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Meta creative

- Excellent instincts around hooks, pacing, storytelling, humour and attention

- Comfortable creating multiple versions of the same creative rather than treating every edit as a single finished piece

- Experience editing UGC and performance-driven creative

- Motion graphics and animation experience is a strong advantage

- Able to take direction while bringing your own creative thinking and ideas to the table

- Comfortable working quickly across multiple projects without sacrificing attention to detail

- Highly organised, with strong file and project management habits

- Collaborative, proactive and comfortable giving and receiving creative feedback

- Naturally interested in social media, internet culture, creative trends and what makes content perform



Nice to have

- Previous experience working specifically with beverage or drinks brands

- Experience working with fast-growing consumer brands

- Experience editing paid social ads and working with performance or growth teams

- Experience working with UGC creators and creator-led content

- Basic graphic design skills

- Experience supporting or working on shoots

- An understanding of how creative performance data can inform future edits

title: Paid Ads Specialist
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly skilled and reliable Media Buyer to take ownership of client ad accounts, starting with our returning clients.



We are bringing on a dedicated Media Buyer to independently manage multiple client accounts, drive consistent performance, and ensure we never have a single point of dependency.



In this role, you will be responsible for planning, launching, testing, managing, optimizing, and scaling paid advertising campaigns across platforms (specifically Meta and Google/YouTube). Your ultimate objective is to meet agreed performance targets (CPL, ROAS, lead volume) while managing spend efficiently and maintaining pristine account health.



Key Responsibilities



Translate client business goals into concrete media plans. 

Determine budget splits, audience targeting, and overall account structure.

Set up campaigns inside ad platforms (Meta Ads Manager, Google/YouTube). 

Configure audiences (lookalike, interest, retargeting, custom), ensure proper conversion tracking (pixels, events, UTMs), and load creative/copy in coordination with our creative team.

Allocate and pace daily/monthly budgets across clients and campaigns. 

Choose bidding strategies, scale winning ads, and cut underperformers to hit efficiency targets.

Monitor performance daily. Run structured tests on creatives, audiences, placements, and offers. 

Reallocate budgets toward winners, flag creative fatigue, and request refreshed assets when needed.

Track core KPIs (CPL, ROAS, CTR, CPM, conversion rate, spend, hook rate, frequency). 

Build clear, client-facing reports and translate raw data into actionable recommendations.

Keep clients updated on performance and strategy. 

Manage expectations and coordinate closely with the creative team and client account managers.

Stay up-to-date on platform changes and ad policies. 

Maintain compliance, resolve ad rejections or restrictions quickly, and proactively notify clients of any billing issues.



Requirements (Non-Negotiables):



Strong, proven background in Meta/Facebook media buying.

Must have experience running Google/YouTube Ads, or possess the ability and willingness to fully ramp up on these platforms within your first 90 days.

Proven history of successfully managing paid accounts and hitting client KPIs.

Deep competence with conversion tracking, including pixels, standard/custom events, and UTM parameters.

Strong ability to read data, build reports, and make data-backed decisions.

Ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously without letting performance or communication slip.

Clear, professional client-facing communication skills.

Deep understanding of platform ad policies to maintain account health.

Experience working with agencies.



Bonus Points (Preferred Qualifications):



Strong instincts for ad creative and direct-response copywriting.

Familiarity with landing page optimization and third-party attribution software.

Prior experience working in an agency environment managing multiple clients.



Success Metrics & Expectations:



(First 30-60 Days): Fully ramped up and independently managing client's Meta ads only. Meeting their agreed KPIs, keeping account health clean, and reporting reliably with minimal oversight.

Managing multiple client accounts independently with consistent performance, maintaining strong client retention, and demonstrating full cross-platform capability (Meta + Google/YouTube) so we can confidently scale client base.

title: Full-Stack Developer / App developer
description:
# Full-Stack Developer / AI Vibe Coder – Inventory System, Apps & Digital Products



## About the Opportunity



I am looking for an experienced **Full-Stack Developer / Product Developer / Technical Lead** to work with me on building an inventory management system, mobile and web applications, and additional software products from **0 to fully working products**.



CAN pay basic hourly rate + percentage from the products  



This is intended to be a **long-term working relationship**.



The first major project is an inventory management platform similar in concept to modern inventory/business management systems. However, the work will not be limited to one application.



We will be developing **apps, websites, business systems, tools, integrations, and other digital products together** as new projects and opportunities come up.



I am looking for someone who can grow with the projects and become a reliable technical development partner.



## What We Will Build



The initial project will include an inventory management system with web and mobile applications.



Depending on the requirements, the system may include:



* Product management

* Inventory and stock tracking

* Warehouses/locations

* Orders

* Purchasing

* Sales

* Customers

* Suppliers

* User accounts

* Roles and permissions

* Dashboards

* Reports

* Notifications

* Barcode/QR functionality

* Integrations

* APIs

* Automated processes

* Business management features

* Mobile functionality

* Web administration

* And additional features as the product develops



But the opportunity is **much bigger than the inventory system**.



We will also have opportunities to create:



* Mobile apps

* Web applications

* SaaS products

* Business management systems

* Internal company tools

* E-commerce-related systems

* Automation systems

* Customer-facing applications

* Websites

* APIs

* Third-party integrations

* AI-powered tools

* Other software products and ideas



The developer will be involved in helping turn these ideas into actual working products.



## From 0 to Product



I need someone who can work with me from the beginning.



You should be comfortable starting with an idea and helping turn it into:



**Idea ? Planning ? UI/UX ? Architecture ? Database ? Development ? Testing ? Launch ? Improvements**



You should be able to help determine:



* What needs to be built

* How it should work

* How the database should be designed

* What technology should be used

* How different systems should communicate

* How the web and mobile applications should connect

* How the product should be structured for future growth



I do not want someone who only waits for every small task to be given to them.



I want someone who can **think with me and help build the product**.



## AI / Vibe Coding



Strong experience with **AI-assisted development / vibe coding** is highly preferred.



We want to use modern AI development tools to make development faster and more efficient.



Experience with tools such as:



* Cursor

* Claude

* ChatGPT

* GitHub Copilot

* AI coding agents

* AI-assisted debugging

* AI-assisted development

* AI-assisted design and planning



is a major advantage.



However, you must actually understand software development.



I am **not looking for someone who simply asks AI to generate code and copies it without understanding what it does**.



You need to be able to review, test, debug, modify, and improve AI-generated code.



## Web + Mobile + More



The developer should ideally be capable of working across:



* Frontend

* Backend

* Databases

* APIs

* Web applications

* Mobile applications

* Cloud systems

* Integrations

* UI/UX

* Deployment

* Maintenance



You do not necessarily need to be the best expert in every single area, but you need to have enough knowledge to build complete products and work with other technologies when required.



## Compensation



The compensation structure will be:



### Basic Hourly Rate + Percentage From the App/Projects



The developer will receive a **basic hourly rate** for the work performed.



In addition to the hourly rate, there will be an opportunity to receive a **percentage from the app/project**, depending on the specific project and agreement.



This means the right developer can have the opportunity to benefit from the success of the products we build together.



The exact percentage, calculation, payment structure, and conditions will be discussed and agreed upon before each applicable project.



I am looking for someone interested in building something **long-term**, rather than someone who only wants to complete a few coding tasks and leave.



## Remote Work



The business and project management will be handled from the **United States**.



The developer will work remotely.



Work will be performed through a **remote connection to my PC**, during agreed scheduled working hours.



Because we will be developing products together and communicating regularly, reliability and availability during the agreed schedule are important.



## What I Need From You



I am looking for someone who:



* Has real development experience

* Can build applications from zero

* Understands full-stack development

* Understands databases and backend architecture

* Can develop web applications

* Can develop or work with mobile applications

* Understands APIs and integrations

* Has good UI/UX understanding

* Can use AI/vibe coding effectively

* Can solve problems independently

* Can suggest better solutions

* Can communicate clearly

* Can work during agreed hours

* Is comfortable with remote PC access

* Is interested in long-term work

* Wants to build multiple products over time

* Takes ownership and pride in their work



## Experience With Similar Projects



Experience with any of the following is a big advantage:



* Inventory systems

* Warehouse management

* ERP

* POS

* E-commerce

* Order management

* Logistics

* SaaS

* Business management software

* Mobile apps

* Multi-user platforms

If you have built something similar, please show examples.



## Long-Term Opportunity



This position can become a long-term opportunity for the right person.



The inventory system is only the beginning.



As we develop the first product, additional ideas and projects will be developed together.



I am looking for someone who wants to be involved in **building multiple applications and systems over time** and potentially grow into a larger technical/product development role.



## How to Apply

20. A short explanation of how you would approach building an inventory system from zero



## Important



Please do not apply if you are only looking for a simple website or a short coding task.



I am looking for someone who can **build real applications and systems**, think about architecture and product design, use modern AI/vibe-coding tools, and work with me to turn ideas into complete products.



If you are the type of developer who enjoys taking an idea from **0 ? design ? development ? launch ? growth**, I would like to hear from you.



**This is an opportunity to work on multiple apps, systems, and projects together, with a basic hourly rate plus the potential to earn a percentage from the success of the applicable apps/projects.**

description:
We are looking for a results-driven Paid Marketing Specialist to plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads 
 & Instagram), and possible other digital advertising channels.



The ideal candidate understands how to turn advertising budgets into measurable business results. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to continuously test and optimize campaigns based on performance data.



Key Responsibilities:

Develop and execute paid advertising strategies aligned with business goals.

Create, launch, and manage Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.

Conduct keyword research, audience research, competitor analysis, and market research.

Develop and optimize campaign structures, ad groups, targeting, bidding, budgets, and ad creatives.

Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Optimize campaigns for leads, conversions, sales, ROAS, CPL, CPA, CTR, and conversion rate.

Perform A/B testing of ads, audiences, landing pages, offers, and campaign strategies.

Monitor daily and weekly advertising spend and ensure campaigns remain within budget.

Analyze campaign data using platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, and Looker Studio.

Track and troubleshoot conversion tracking, pixels, events, and other marketing technologies.

Work closely with content writers, graphic designers, web developers, and other marketing team members.

Provide clear performance reports and explain campaign results to management or clients.

Identify underperforming campaigns and implement corrective strategies.

Stay updated on changes in advertising platforms, algorithms, policies, and best practices.

Help develop landing page and funnel recommendations to improve conversion rates.

Maintain organized documentation of campaign strategies, tests, results, and optimizations.

Required Qualifications

Proven experience managing Google Ads and/or Meta Ads campaigns.

Strong understanding of PPC and paid digital marketing principles.

Experience with campaign setup, optimization, budgeting, targeting, and reporting.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to interpret advertising data and make data-driven decisions.

Understanding of conversion tracking and digital analytics.

Familiarity with GA4 and Google Tag Manager is highly preferred.

Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

Google Ads certifications.

Meta Blueprint certification.

Experience with B2B lead generation and/or eCommerce advertising.

Experience with landing page optimization and conversion rate optimization (CRO).

Knowledge of SEO and organic digital marketing.

Experience with Looker Studio or other reporting platforms.

Basic understanding of WordPress, Shopify, or other website platforms.

Experience working with marketing teams, agencies, or multiple clients.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be evaluated based on:



Lead and conversion volume

Cost per lead (CPL) / cost per acquisition (CPA)

Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

Conversion rate

Click-through rate (CTR)

Quality of leads or conversions

Advertising budget efficiency

Campaign growth and scalability

Accuracy and timeliness of reporting

Continuous testing and optimization

What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who does more than simply launch ads. The right candidate should be able to understand the entire customer journey from the advertisement and targeting to the landing page, conversion tracking, and final business result.



A successful Paid Marketing Specialist should be analytical, proactive, curious, and results-oriented, with the ability to identify problems, test solutions, and continuously improve campaign performance.

A key first responsibility will be completing two existing projects: an automated DNSP application workflow and a single line diagram creator. Both have working foundations, but need an experienced developer to finish them and prepare them for regular production use.

This is not a junior role. You need to be comfortable understanding an existing codebase, making technical decisions and taking work through to completion.

What you will do

Build and maintain full-stack web applications.

Complete existing browser automation and document-generation projects.

Develop features for Flutter mobile apps.

Integrate external APIs and services.

Diagnose and fix production issues.

Write tests for important workflows.

Review existing code before replacing or rebuilding it.

Work directly with the founder to turn business requirements into working software.

Keep technical documentation current.

Technical skills

You should have strong experience with:

TypeScript

React

Node.js and Express

PostgreSQL and Supabase

REST APIs, webhooks and OAuth

Playwright or similar browser automation tools

Git, automated testing and production debugging

Cloud deployment and secret management

You must also be able to work with:

Flutter and Dart

Firebase and Firestore

Next.js

SVG and PDF generation

Experience with workflow automation, SaaS products, technical diagrams or solar software will be useful, but solar knowledge is not required.

Give AI tools clear context, constraints and acceptance criteria.

Use AI to help plan, build, debug, test and document software.

Identify incorrect assumptions, security problems and incomplete solutions.

Test AI features against clear examples instead of relying on a quick demonstration.

We are looking for someone who uses AI to improve their output while still applying strong software engineering judgment.

You will suit this role if you:

Have shipped and maintained production software.

Can take ownership of unfinished work and bring it to completion.

Communicate clearly about progress and blockers.

Can work independently.

Care about correctness, security and usability.

Are comfortable working across web, mobile, automation and AI projects.

Please include:

A short introduction.

Links to your GitHub, portfolio or software you helped build.

An example of a difficult automation or integration you completed.

A real example of how you used an AI coding tool on a substantial project.

What the AI helped with, what it got wrong and how you checked the final result.

The parts of our technology stack you know best.

Your availability and expected monthly rate.

title: Full Cycle Bookkeeper - Experienced 5 yr +
description:
Read this entire posting before applying. If you skip to the apply button, you will be rejected automatically.

I am done wasting time and money on VAs who overpromise and underdeliver. This posting is intentionally blunt so only qualified, serious candidates apply. If you do not meet ALL of the requirements below, do not apply — you will not be considered, and applications that ignore this will be deleted without a response.

Non-Negotiable Requirements — ALL of these are deal-breakers if not met:



1 -Speak and write English clearly. If you have a thick accent or are not fluent in written and spoken English, do not apply. This is an immediate disqualifier.

2 - Be an actual, hands-on expert in bookkeeping, payroll, and HR administration. I use QuickBooks Online, Cin7 Core for inventory/COGS, QBO for AP, and QBO for payroll. If you claim experience with these tools and then have to Google how to do basic tasks once hired, this is an immediate disqualifier. You will be tested before hire — see below.

3 - Explain things simply. I am not an accountant. If I ask you a question and you can't break it down in plain language I understand right away, do not apply. I need someone who translates the technical into the simple, not someone who talks over my head.

4 - Follow instructions exactly. I have had VAs guess at what I wanted, get "creative," do work I never asked for, and then expect to be paid for it. This happens ONCE and we're done. I am open to your suggestions on better ways to do things — but only with my approval before you act. Suggest, don't assume.

5 - Do not pad your hours. I know roughly how long tasks take, and I am generous about it. If I see 15-minute tasks billed as multi-hour tasks, my generosity disappears immediately and so does the job.

6 - Show up on time, every time. I understand life happens — tell me in advance and I will be understanding. Chronic lateness or last-minute excuses (storms, internet outages, etc., without advance notice) will end this immediately. One strike.

7 - We pay via Payoneer ONLY. No exceptions. If you don't have a Payoneer account or can't set one up, do not apply. This is nonnegotiable — no PayPal, no Wise, no bank transfer, no other method.

8 - We track time using Timeproof. Mandatory, no exceptions. If you are not willing to use Timeproof for every hour billed, do not apply. This is not up for discussion.

9 - Meetings are professional — no children visible or audible on camera. These are leadership meetings. My team does not bring kids into the office, and I expect the same from you. Have children asleep, at school, or with another caregiver during our scheduled meeting times. If a child is on camera or heard in the background, the meeting will end.

10 - If I call you during paid hours, you answer. Period. No exceptions, no "I saw it but was busy." If you're on the clock, you're reachable.



What You'll Be Doing:



Full-cycle bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online — transaction coding, reconciliations, AP/AR

Inventory and COGS tracking and reconciliation in Cin7 Core

Vendor bill capture, approval routing, and payment processing through or QBO

Payroll support and coordination through Paylocity

HR administrative support — onboarding documentation, recordkeeping, basic compliance tasks

Monthly financial reporting to ownership



Application Instructions — Read Carefully:



To prove you read this far, start your application with the word LEDGER in the subject line. Applications without it will not be opened.

Confirm in your application that you have a Payoneer account, are willing to use Timeproof for every hour worked, can keep meetings child-free, and will answer calls during paid hours. If you don't confirm all four, your application will be skipped.

Include your specific hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online and/or Cin7 Core — not "familiar with," actual experience.

Include your available start date and your hourly rate expectation.

Be prepared to complete a short paid skills test before any offer is made.



This is a long-term, part-time position for the right person, with room to grow. If you meet every requirement above and can prove it, I want to hear from you. If you don't, please save us both the time.

title: Property Management Operations Assistant | Australian Real Estate
description:
Monarch Estate Agents is a Melbourne-based property business looking for an experienced Property Management Operations Assistant to become a reliable extension of our team.



This is a full-time, long-term remote role supporting the day-to-day operations of our property management portfolio.



We’re looking for someone who moves quickly, communicates exceptionally well, notices the small details and keeps everyone updated without needing to be asked.



What you’ll be doing —



You’ll support our team across:



* Maintenance requests and contractor coordination

* Calling and communicating with trades, renters and rental providers

* Obtaining and following up quotes

* Rental arrears and follow-ups

* Lease renewals

* Rental application screening and summaries

* Routine inspection scheduling

* PropertyMe records and task management

*
s, documentation and general administration

* Daily task tracking, follow-ups and progress summaries



What matters to us —



1. Communication



You need to be confident communicating by both phone and
 with trades, renters and rental providers.



We want someone who can have a conversation, understand what’s happening, take clear notes and communicate the important information back to the team.



2. Proactivity



Don’t wait for someone to ask:



“Where is this up to?”



If you’ve finished your current task, check what’s outstanding and move onto the next priority.



If something is waiting on another person, follow it up.



If something needs attention, flag it.



And keep the team updated as you go.



3. Speed



Property management moves quickly.



We’re looking for someone who can understand a task, take action and work efficiently without sacrificing accuracy.



4. Attention to detail



The small things matter.



Was the correct photo uploaded?



Is the PropertyMe record accurate?



Does the write-up make sense?



Is important information missing?



Has the follow-up actually been scheduled?



We want someone who naturally checks their work before considering something complete.



5. Ownership



A task isn’t finished because an
 was sent.



It’s finished when the outcome has been followed through, the records are correct and the relevant people know where things stand.



You’ll be a strong fit if you:



* Have previous experience with Australian property management

* Have strong working knowledge of PropertyMe

* Understand maintenance, arrears, renewals, applications and inspections

* Have excellent spoken and written English

* Are confident speaking with trades, renters and rental providers

* Work quickly and independently

* Take clear, useful notes

* Proactively provide updates and task summaries

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Can manage multiple priorities without needing constant direction

* Have reliable internet and a professional home-office setup



The position—



* Full-time, Monday–Friday

* Remote

* Working in alignment with Melbourne business hours

* Long-term position

* Training provided on Monarch’s specific processes

* Opportunity to grow with the agency



We’re not looking for a long, generic cover letter.



And please don’t send us an AI-generated essay telling us you’re a “detail-oriented, proactive self-starter.”



We’d rather meet the actual person.



Please send:



1. Your resume

2. A short overview of your Australian property management experience

3. Your experience with PropertyMe

4. Your expected hourly rate or monthly salary

5. Your availability during Melbourne business hours

6. A link to a 2–3 minute Loom video answering:



Why did this particular role stand out to you?



What experience do you have that would make you genuinely useful to Monarch?



And one personal question: What is something you genuinely enjoy outside of work?



There is no correct answer to the last question. We just want to know a little about the person behind the application.



What happens next?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical trial of approximately one hour, using tasks similar to the work you’ll actually be doing at Monarch.



We’ll be looking at how you communicate, prioritise, work through information, catch details and get things done.



The strongest applicants will then progress to a final interview.



Start your application with the word “MONARCH” so we know you’ve read the full listing.



If this sounds like the way you naturally work, we’d love to hear from you.

title: # Beauty Industry Research & Market Insights Analyst
description:
**The Online Beauty Warehouse**



The Online Beauty Warehouse is looking for a commercially minded **Research & Market Insights Analyst** to help us understand what is happening across the Australian professional beauty industry before it becomes obvious.



This is not a traditional SEO role and it is not simply about producing keyword reports.



We want someone who can combine **search behaviour, trend data, competitor research, customer behaviour and our own internal sales data** to identify what is growing, what is declining, what is emerging and what beauty businesses should be paying attention to.



Our goal is to build an ongoing proprietary intelligence platform around the Australian beauty industry and turn that research into genuinely useful information for salon, clinic, spa and beauty-business owners.



## What you'll be researching



You may investigate questions such as:



* Which beauty treatments are growing fastest in Australia?

* Which previously popular treatments are losing consumer interest?

* What terminology are consumers beginning to use?

* What treatments have strong "near me" search intent?

* What beauty categories are showing early signs of breakout growth?

* Which trends appear to be peaking?

* What are salon and clinic owners investing in?

* Which equipment categories are gaining or losing momentum?

* Are changes in consumer searches reflected in actual purchasing behaviour?

* Which Australian cities are showing the strongest demand for particular treatments?

* What are consumers asking about now that they weren't asking 12 months ago?



For example, rather than simply reporting that "lymphatic drainage is popular", we want to understand:



* current Australian search demand

* 12-month change

* three-year change

* geographical demand

* related emerging searches

* commercial-intent searches

* competing terminology

* seasonality

* TOBW website interest

* customer enquiries

* equipment and consumable sales



The objective is to turn multiple signals into useful commercial intelligence.



## Key responsibilities



* Conduct ongoing Australian beauty and wellness market research

* Analyse Google search behaviour and search-volume trends

* Use Google Trends to identify rising, declining and breakout categories

* Conduct detailed keyword and topic research

* Build groups of related search terms rather than relying on single keywords

* Monitor treatment, product and equipment categories over time

* Identify emerging terminology and changes in consumer language

* Analyse geographic differences across Australia

* Monitor competitor websites, product ranges and category expansion

* Track new beauty treatments, equipment and business models

* Analyse TOBW website, enquiry and sales data where provided

* Compare consumer search behaviour against actual B2B purchasing behaviour

* Maintain historical datasets so changes can be measured month to month and year to year

* Develop clear classifications such as **Breaking Out, Growing, Hot, Peaking, Cooling, Declining and Watch**

* Create charts, tables and summaries that make complex information easy to understand

* Identify interesting findings that could become reports, newsletters, articles or social content

* Assist with the annual Australian Beauty Business Survey

* Cross-analyse survey responses against search and transactional data

* Fact-check findings before publication

* Clearly distinguish correlation, consumer interest and actual commercial performance



## Tools you may use



Experience with some of the following would be highly regarded:



* Google Trends

* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics / GA4

* Ubersuggest

* Semrush

* Ahrefs

* Google Keyword Planner

* Google Sheets

* Microsoft Excel

* Looker Studio

* Data visualisation tools

* AI research and analysis tools



You do not need experience with every platform.



More important is your ability to **find the right information, question what the data actually means and identify commercially useful patterns.**



## What we're looking for



You will suit this role if you:



* enjoy research and finding patterns others miss

* are comfortable working with large amounts of information

* understand the difference between a trend and a temporary spike

* can interpret data rather than simply report numbers

* are naturally sceptical and check your conclusions

* understand search intent and consumer behaviour

* can explain data in plain English

* have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

* are highly organised

* can maintain consistent datasets over long periods

* have excellent attention to detail

* can work independently and investigate a subject thoroughly

* are commercially minded and interested in why businesses make money



Experience in **beauty, aesthetics, wellness, hair, salon software, market research, SEO, e-commerce or business intelligence** would be advantageous but is not essential.



### To apply



Please send your resume along with a short explanation of your research or analytical experience.



As part of your application, please also provide **one example of a trend you believe is currently emerging or declining within beauty, aesthetics, hair or wellness, and briefly explain what evidence you would use to determine whether it is a genuine trend.**

title: Customer Support Manager (Retention, LTV, Chargebacks) US/UK Supplement Brand · $1,600/mo + Uncapped Growth Potential
description:
ABOUT US:

We're a US direct-to-consumer supplement brand running on Shopify. Our customers are mostly Americans and Brits aged 50+ who buy a premium heart-health product on subscription. We're profitable, scaling on paid ads, and we run a lean remote team — much of it already Filipino, and we've had excellent experiences.



We're hiring a Customer Support Manager to own retention. Read that carefully, because it changes what this job is. You are not here to close tickets — you're here to keep subscribers paying, raise their lifetime value, and train the support team to do the same, while keeping refunds and chargebacks on the floor.



This is a quasi-sales role. Every subscriber you save pays you a percentage of their lifetime value, every month, with no cap. The person who wants a comfortable salary will be bored here. The person who wants their income tied to numbers they control will do very well.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own our churn number. Loop Subscriptions cancel flows, pause and skip offers, downgrade paths, win-back sequences — you build them, test them, and report on them.

- Own LTV. Upgrade paths, bundle offers, subscription upsells at the right moment in the customer relationship. Growing an existing subscriber is cheaper than buying a new one, and that is your job.

- Own our Klaviyo lifecycle flows. Post-purchase, shipping, onboarding, results-expectation, pre-renewal, win-back. Our product works gradually, our guarantee has a window, and our shipping crosses borders — most of our tickets and most of our churn come from customers who were never told what to expect and when. You fix that upstream, in the flows, before it ever reaches the inbox.

- Keep refunds and chargebacks at a minimum — build the evidence packs, submit representments in Disputify, and fix the upstream reasons disputes happen in the first place.

- Manage and train our support reps on retention. They handle the frontline inbox; you make sure every one of them can hold a save conversation instead of processing a cancellation. Coaching, ticket reviews, QA.

- Write and maintain the SOPs the team runs on, including the medication escalation script

- Build and maintain our help center and macro library — kill the reasons tickets get opened, not just the tickets

- Handle escalations personally, including occasional voice calls with US/UK customers aged 50+

- Design AI-driven support workflows that cut ticket volume, prevent chargebacks, reduce churn, and lift LTV

- Own the weekly report to the founder: churn rate, save rate, LTV, refund rate, chargeback win rate, first response time, ticket resolution time



REQUIREMENTS — PLEASE DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT THESE



- Hands-on Loop Subscriptions experience. You've built cancel flows, offers, and dunning inside Loop, not just clicked around it. Tell us what you built and what it moved.

- Hands-on Klaviyo experience building
/SMS flows — specifically flows that manage expectations around product results, guarantees, and shipping times. You understand that a well-timed "here's what week 3 feels like"
 is worth more than a hundred perfect ticket replies, and you can point to flows you built that cut tickets or churn.

- Demonstrated churn reduction and LTV growth. You have numbers. Before and after. If you can't put figures on your retention work, you're not the person for this role.

- You keep refunds and chargebacks low while doing it. Anyone can cut churn by never letting people leave. We want retention that doesn't come back as a dispute six weeks later.

- Experience managing and training support reps. You've coached people, run QA, and held a team to numbers.

- Several years of hands-on Shopify experience. Admin panel cold: orders, refunds, fulfillments, customer profiles. We verify this.

- Excellent written English. Your
s go straight to American and British customers with our brand name on them. Near-native written English is required, not preferred.

- Comfortable on voice/phone calls with a neutral accent.
-first role, but retention saves and escalations sometimes happen live, with customers aged 50+, during normal business hours.

- Prior support experience in supplements, health, medical devices, or pharmacy. You understand where the line sits between explaining a label and giving medical advice, and you hold it under pressure.

- Chargeback evidence-pack construction — not just "I've used Disputify," but knowing what wins a representment: delivery confirmation, terms acceptance, communication logs, policy screenshots

- Experience building or maintaining a help center or macro library

- Experience with a helpdesk platform — Gorgias, Zendesk, especially Commslayer

- Experience with HubStaff for employee time tracking

- Flexible around EST or GMT timezone

- Reliable internet, backup connection or power, quiet workspace



HOURS



Approximately 50 hours per week, 200 hours per month on average

You can take a day or two off during the week, no problem — just make the hours up on your other days. We care about hours delivered and results, not which day you sat down, unless otherwise noted or some unusual internal deadline is coming up.

If we're understaffed and you want to earn more, you can request extra hours. We'd rather pay you than hire a second person.



PAY — READ THIS PART



Base: $8.00 USD/hour — approximately $1,600 USD/month at 200 hours

Plus a percentage of the lifetime value of every subscriber you save, paid monthly, with no cap. This is the real compensation. Our subscribers are long-term and our AOV is high, so a manager who moves churn a few points meaningfully changes their own income.

Additional performance bonuses on KPIs: chargeback win rate, refund rate, LTV growth

Long-term role. We're hiring someone to own this function completely as we scale, and to build the team under them.



BEFORE YOU START



Every hire completes these four steps before their first shift:



A short interview call with our founder. Quick and easy — we just want to hear you talk.

Sign our agreements — employment contract, non-disclosure, and non-compete. Standard documents, sent digitally for e-signature.

Install HubStaff on your work machine. Hours are tracked through it so we can make efficiency gains without micromanaging you.

Complete our training courses — product knowledge, SOPs, tone of voice, and the medication escalation script. (Paid)



Voila, now you're ready to start. We invest heavily in onboarding because we're hiring for the long term, not for a month. In return we expect you to take it seriously.



HOW TO APPLY



Reply with the following. Applications missing any item WILL be skipped:



Start your message with the word "Natto" so we know you read this in full

Your Shopify experience — which store categories, what you did, how long

Your Loop Subscriptions experience — what you built inside it, and what happened to churn

Your Klaviyo experience — which flows you built, and what they did to ticket volume or churn. If you've built a results-expectation or shipping-expectation flow specifically, describe it.

Your best retention result with real numbers. Churn before, churn after, over what period, on what size subscriber base. What did you actually change?

How you kept refunds and chargebacks down while doing it

How many support reps you've managed and trained, and how you held them to numbers

Which helpdesk tools you have the most experience with and preference for, and why

Your available working hours in EST or GMT

Your expected hourly rate



Lastly, answer both of these:



In 2–3 sentences. A 71-year-old customer
s: "I'm on Blood Thinners and my Doctor didn't say anything specific about your heart health supplement. Can I take 2 capsules a day?" Write the exact reply you would send him.

In 4–6 sentences. A subscriber on month 3 writes: "I haven't noticed anything yet, please cancel my subscription." Write the exact reply you would send her.

title: URGENT - Marketing Paid Growth Specialist
description:
About Us



We are a fast-growing digital company looking for an experienced Paid Growth Specialist to join our marketing team.



This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys paid advertising, analyzing performance, testing new ideas, and finding ways to improve results.



Unlike an agency environment where you may manage many different clients, this position will primarily focus on two accounts, allowing you to really understand the businesses and focus on improving performance.



You'll also work alongside team members focused on creative, content, SEO, conversion optimization, and outreach, so you can focus primarily on what you do best — paid advertising and growth.



Work Schedule & Compensation

Hours: Full-time, Monday through Friday

Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 2:00 PM–12:00 AM Philippine Time, with some flexibility in working hours. The later portion of the schedule provides regular overlap with our U.S.-based team.

Workweek: Approximately 40 hours of core work plus 5 hours of dedicated innovation, research, and learning time each week. Includes a 1-hour paid lunch daily and reasonable short breaks as needed.

Paid Lunch: 1 hour per day

Reasonable short breaks throughout the day as needed

Innovation Time: Approximately 5 paid hours per week dedicated to research, learning, testing, and new ideas

PTO: 12 paid time-off days annually

Location: Remote – Philippines

Long-term position with opportunities for increased compensation and responsibility based on performance



Role Overview

You will manage and optimize paid advertising across our primary marketing channels.



We're looking for someone who can handle the day-to-day management of campaigns while also thinking proactively about how to improve performance.



We don't expect you to know everything on day one. We want someone with strong paid advertising fundamentals who is analytical, curious, dependable, and always interested in learning and improving.



Key Responsibilities



Paid Advertising

Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns, including Search and Performance Max

Manage Meta/Facebook and Instagram advertising

Manage and test Reddit advertising

Monitor campaign performance, budgets, CPA, ROAS, conversions, and other key metrics

Perform keyword, search term, audience, and competitor research

Manage retargeting and remarketing campaigns

Identify opportunities to improve and expand campaigns

Monitor ads for performance issues, disapprovals, or tracking problems



Testing & Growth

Test new campaigns, audiences, keywords, ads, and creative ideas

Identify new paid advertising opportunities

Monitor competitor advertising and industry trends

Work with our creative team to develop new advertising assets

Recommend landing page or messaging improvements based on advertising performance

Use dedicated innovation time to research and propose new growth ideas



Analytics & Reporting

Review advertising and conversion data

Prepare clear weekly performance reports

Identify winners, losers, trends, and opportunities

Monitor conversion tracking and campaign attribution

Explain what changed, what was learned, and what should happen next



Collaboration

Work closely with our marketing supervisor and other marketing specialists

Participate in regular team meetings

Communicate campaign needs to our creative and content team

Share ideas, findings, and opportunities with the team



Requirements

2+ years of hands-on paid advertising experience

Strong experience with Google Ads

Experience with Meta/Facebook/Instagram Ads

Understanding of CPA, ROAS, conversion rates, and other paid advertising metrics

Experience with Google Analytics / GA4

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Comfortable working with data and spreadsheets

Good written and spoken English

Strong attention to detail

Ability to work independently and take ownership of your responsibilities

Reliable internet connection and ability to work remotely



Experience That Is a Plus

Google Performance Max

Google Shopping / Merchant Center

Reddit Ads

YouTube Ads

Google Tag Manager

Looker Studio

Conversion tracking

A/B testing

Landing page optimization

Experience using AI tools to improve research, analysis, reporting, or campaign management

Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who doesn't just maintain campaigns.



We want someone who is curious when performance changes, enjoys digging into the data, finds opportunities without always being asked, and brings new ideas to the team.



If you enjoy paid advertising, analytics, testing, learning, and figuring out how to make campaigns perform better, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Direct Response Ad Designer (Meta + TikTok) - Health Wearable Brand
description:
ABOUT US

We're a UK direct-to-consumer brand selling health and fitness wearables. We sell through our own store and run paid social every day. We move fast, and decisions get made in hours rather than weeks.



THE ROLE

You'll design the static ad creative we run on Meta and TikTok. This is performance design, not brand design - the job is ads that stop the scroll and get the click, tested in volume and iterated on based on what the numbers say.



Typical week:

· 8–15 new static ad concepts

· Variations on whichever ads are already winning (new hooks, new angles, new headlines)

· Resizing winners across 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16

· Occasional landing page and
 graphics



WHAT YOU NEED

· Strong portfolio of paid social ads - actual ads that ran, not brand or logo work

· Figma or Photoshop, working fast and cleanly with layers and components

· An eye for the native look - ads that don't feel like ads

· Good English for reading briefs and writing headline text on creative

· Reliable overlap with UK hours for a short daily check-in



NICE TO HAVE

· Experience with health, fitness, supplements or consumer tech

· Basic video editing for simple cutdowns

· Comfortable working from an existing brand style rather than inventing your own



HOW TO APPLY

Send:

1. Your portfolio, with at least 5 paid social ads you designed

2. One sentence on which of those performed best and why you think it did

3. Your monthly rate



Start your message with the word BOLT so I know you read this properly. Applications without it won't be opened.



We will reply to everyone who follows the instructions above.

title: Article Writer
description:
Hey!



I run a UK health wearable brand and we're looking for someone to write and build our advertorial pages - the long-form "best of" and review-style articles that sit behind paid social traffic.



The work is both halves: writing the copy, and building the page in LightFunnels. That second part matters - I'd rather not hand off a doc and rebuild it myself, so you'd own the page end to end.



What I'm after:



· Direct response copy that converts cold traffic, not brand writing

· Comfortable in LightFunnels, or confident you'd pick it up fast (it's a visual builder, no code needed)

· Willing to work inside advertising rules - UK health and wellness claims have real limits and I'd rather build within them than get pages pulled



Starting with one page as a paid test, then ongoing if it works - we run these continuously and there's steady volume.



If that sounds like your thing, send me a couple of advertorials you've written, ideally with any performance numbers you're able to share. Happy to talk rates once I've seen the work.
