title: Virtual Receptionist VA (Remote) | Fast Hiring – 24-Hour Review
description:
**IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING**



We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance.



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a call-handling role, we also have a few non-voice positions available, subject to availability and overall fit. If you are interested, please clearly state that you are interested in a non-voice role and submit a brief three-sentence introduction about yourself along with your portfolio or work samples.



Please note our application process: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to respond individually to every applicant who is not selected. If you do not receive a response from us within 24 hours with information about the next step in the hiring process, you were not selected to move forward to the next round. We appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.



————————————————————



**To apply:** Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly. Please answer based on your own personal experience and provide specific, real examples whenever requested. Incomplete, vague, generic, or copied responses may not be considered.



**(1)** Which city and region in the Philippines are you currently located in? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



**(2)** Please submit a link to a screenshot of your internet speed and links to a few samples of your previous work output or portfolio. Please indicate what work you personally completed.



**(3)** Please submit links to two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund.

**(6)** Describe three work tasks you have personally completed at least 100 times in a real job. For each task, give a specific example of when you performed the task, explain exactly what you did in your own words, identify the actual tools or systems you used, and describe the final result. Include any specific details, numbers, or challenges you remember from doing the task.



**(7)** If you were hired today, what are three specific work tasks you believe you could fully handle on your own within your first week? For each example, describe the exact task, the tools or software involved, and what successful completion would look like.



**(8)** What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



**(9)** Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

title: UGC Manager (Full-Time, Long-Term) - Swedish Menswear Brand
description:
ABOUT US



We are a Swedish menswear brand run by two founders, full-time for two years. No logos, honest pricing, real materials: wool, linen, cotton. Quiet luxury without the logo tax. We sell direct across Europe and the UK aswell worldwide and we grow almost entirely on creator content.



THE ROLE



Employment type: Full-time, 40 hours per week, 100% remote

Compensation: $1,000 to $1,200 USD per month, depending on experience

Reports to: Co-founder

Level: Manager, department owner



This is not a junior coordinator, a virtual assistant, or a basic influencer outreach position. You will not be posting to our feed or answering customer
s.



Creator content is the single channel this company grows on, and it has outgrown the two founders running it on the side. We are hiring one person to own it, and not someone who needs to be told every step. We want someone who can take the pipeline as it is today, see what is broken in it, and build it into something that runs.



YOUR MISSION



Turn a steady flow of the right creators into a steady flow of ads that sell. You own:



- Creator sourcing and daily outreach on Instagram and TikTok

- Qualification against our fit checklist: 10k+ followers or reels that regularly clear 20k views, 2%+ engagement, men 18 to 45, EU/UK/Nordic, smart-casual

- Every reply after first contact: rates, negotiation, terms, confirmation. Nothing sits past 48 hours

- Product seeding end to end, from raising the Shopify order to chasing what is stuck

- Briefs, reference videos and deadlines, holding a 7-day turnaround from the day product arrives

- Content review against the brief, reshoot requests, and collecting the ad code for our media buyers

- D
 which creators are worth upgrading to a retainer and which to cut

- Keeping the pipeline current so anyone can see its true state without asking you



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- 1+ years managing UGC creators or influencer partnerships for a DTC or ecommerce brand

- Proven with gifted and seeded deals, not only paid ones. Getting a creator to film for product is a core skill here

- Comfortable with high daily outreach volume, and with people not replying

- Genuinely organised. 30+ active creators takes systems, not memory

- Written English that sounds like a person who watched their content, not a template

- Taste: you can tell content that stops the scroll from content that merely looks nice

- Warm with creators, firm when work is late or off-brief

- Full-time, reliably overlapping European hours, looking for a long-term home



Fashion or menswear experience is a plus, not a requirement. So is familiarity with Meta Partnership Ads and TikTok Spark Ads.



WHAT THIS ROLE HAS THAT OTHERS DO NOT



- A real system, not a spreadsheet. We built our own dashboard, the Command Center, which holds the whole creator pipeline: who was contacted, what stage they are at, what is owed, what is overdue. Most jobs like this fall apart at 40 creators. Yours will not.

- Direct access to the founders. No middle management. Bring an idea on Monday, get a decision on Monday.

- We are AI-forward and we mean it. If you already reach for AI to move faster, there is room here.

- Ask for the tool that makes you faster and we buy it.

- This seat is the lead of our Content Engine. Creators, editors and outreach support sit under it as we scale.



COMPENSATION



$1,000 to $1,200 USD per month, plus a performance bonus tied to content delivered and creators converted. Strong candidates start at $1,000 with a written review at 90 days that moves them to the top of the band.



HOW TO APPLY



Follow this exactly. It takes about 15 minutes and it is how we find the people who actually read.



1. Begin your application with this exact line: "I own the pipeline."

2. Your relevant experience: which brands, how many creators, what you personally handled, and what came of it.

3. Find one creator on Instagram or TikTok who fits a Swedish menswear brand selling to men 18 to 45 in Europe. Paste the link and two sentences on why they would convert for us.

4. Write the exact DM you would send that creator: free product in exchange for a video we can run as a Meta ad.

5. Tell us how you would handle a creator who received the product, missed the deadline by a week, and stopped replying.

title: FRACTIONAL E-COMMERCE GROWTH & PROJECT LEAD
description:
Fur Theory is an Australian premium dog care and modern dog living brand created for people who believe their dogs are part of the home, not separate from it.



We are preparing to launch our first two products:

No. 01 — The Barrier Wash

No. 02 — The Restore Mist



The brand has a refined, editorial positioning rather than a traditional pet-store aesthetic. We are currently in the pre-launch/launch stage. The Shopify website is substantially underway, Klaviyo, GA4 and tracking have already been started, and we have a VA supporting execution. We are now looking for someone experienced to lead the commercial growth project from this point forward.



THE ROLE

:: I am looking for an experienced e-commerce growth operator/project lead who can look at the entire customer journey, determine what needs to happen, coordinate the right specialists and make commercially sound decisions about where time and money should go.



You will work with specialist resources across:

:: Shopify/web development

:: Klaviyo/email automation

:: Meta advertising

:: Creative strategy and production

:: SEO

:: Social/content

:: VA/execution support



You do not need to personally execute every one of these disciplines. Your job is to lead the system and make sure the pieces work together.



You will own:

:: The 90-day growth plan

:: Weekly priorities and execution

:: Coordination of specialist contractors

:: Launch readiness

:: Customer acquisition strategy

:: Funnel performance

:: Lead-generation testing

:: Meta advertising strategy and specialist oversight

:: Creative testing roadmap

:: Klaviyo/customer journey strategy

:: Website conversion priorities

:: KPI tracking and weekly reporting

:: Budget allocation and spending decisions

:: Identifying bottlenecks in the customer journey

:: D
 what should be fixed, tested, paused or scaled



The ultimate objective is to build a repeatable customer acquisition and retention system and work toward significant revenue growth, with $100K+ revenue as the initial commercial milestone — not a guaranteed outcome.



WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR

:: You should have real hands-on e-commerce/DTC growth experience, not simply knowledge of marketing platforms.

:: You need to understand how these pieces connect:

Ad ? landing/product page ? add to cart ? checkout ? purchase ? post-purchase ? repeat purchase

:: You should understand the relationship between:

Traffic

CTR

CPC

Landing-page conversion

Add-to-cart rate

Checkout conversion

CPA

ROAS

AOV

Customer acquisition cost

Repeat purchase

 revenue

And, importantly, know what to do when one of those numbers isn't working.



YOU MUST HAVE PROVEN EXPERIENCE

Please don't apply with generic statements such as: "I can manage Meta, Shopify, Klaviyo, SEO and social media."

I want evidence. Please provide at least 2 relevant e-commerce/DTC examples and for each one tell me:

What was the business/product?

What was the approximate monthly ad spend?

What was the starting point?

What result was achieved?

Over what timeframe?

What did you personally do?

What changed because of your work?

Were you working independently or as part of a larger team?

Recent examples are strongly preferred.

Team/agency results that you cannot personally substantiate will not be considered your individual results.



THE FIRST TASK — IMPORTANT

Before I interview you, I want to see how you actually think. Please provide a practical 30-day plan for Fur Theory based on the information above.



Your plan should cover:

Week 1

What would you review first and why?

Week 2

What would you prioritise and what specialists would you need?

Week 3

What would you test?

Week 4

What would you measure and how would you d
 what happens next?



Also include:

Your proposed initial marketing budget

What you would not spend money on yet

The first KPIs you would monitor

What you believe should be completed before launching paid traffic

What you would test before the website is fully live, if anything

How you would coordinate the specialists

What you would report to me each week

I am much more interested in the quality of your thinking than a long application.



WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU A GREAT FIT

You are:

Commercially minded

Analytical

Proactive

Highly organised

Comfortable making decisions

Comfortable managing specialists

Comfortable challenging poor work

Focused on outcomes rather than activity

Experienced with Shopify/DTC

Strong in Meta/customer acquisition strategy

Comfortable understanding Klaviyo and lifecycle marketing

Able to distinguish a traffic problem from a conversion problem

Able to work from data rather than assumptions

You should be comfortable telling me:

"Don't spend money on that yet."

if the numbers or the stage of the business don't justify it.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

This is not:

? A social media posting role

? A VA role

? A generic digital marketing role

? A pure Meta Ads role

? A Shopify developer role

? A content creator role

? A person who simply coordinates meetings and tasks

? A "jack of all trades" position



INITIAL HOURS & RATE

Approximately 10 hours per week initially.



Please provide:

Your hourly rate OR your proposed monthly retainer for approximately 10 hours/week, Your availability. This will initially be a working engagement based on delivery and results, with the potential to increase hours and responsibility as the brand grows.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. Your relevant e-commerce/DTC experience

2. Two recent case studies with actual numbers

3. Your 30-day Fur Theory plan

4. Your hourly rate or monthly retainer

5. Your availability

6. A short explanation of why you believe you are suited to LEADING an e-commerce growth project rather than simply executing one marketing channel.



Applications that only say "I can do everything" without evidence will not be considered.



Please put "FUR THEORY GROWTH LEAD" in the subject line of your application.

description:
We’re looking for a Football YouTube Scriptwriter & Researcher for a long-term faceless YouTube channel.



Our videos focus on entertaining football topics such as crazy red cards, emotional moments, fights, legendary goals, controversial moments, etc.



What you’ll do:



Research football topics using reference videos we provide

Select the best moments/i
 for each video

Write engaging 10–12 minute English YouTube scripts

Fact-check players, matches and events

For every section, provide the player/match + search terms/clip notes so our editor can easily find the correct footage

Write for retention: strong hooks, storytelling and no unnecessary filler



Requirements:



Strong knowledge of football/soccer

Proven experience writing YouTube scripts

Excellent English

Able to research independently

Understanding of faceless YouTube content is a big plus



We’re looking for someone long-term, with regular weekly work.



Budget: $5/hour



When applying, send:



Your best script samples

Your experience with football content

How long a 10–12 minute researched script usually takes you



Start your application with RED CARD so I know you read the full post.
